review_text: AC Hotel was in the perfect location for us, sitting about halfway between the airport and the cruise terminals. We were able to get a ride share easily to and from the hotel's front door. Sharing a meal on the rooftop at night was spectacular as well as getting breakfast on the first floor in the morning. Yummy food! My favorite part of our stay was interacting with AC's friendly and helpful staff. Smiles and kindness overflows at this hotel.

Sheryl at the front desk was so helpful; she had a long line and was by herself but when it came my turn she helped me out with kindness and patience. The room is clean; recommend ocean view room. The rooftop bar / pool / lounge area is lovely. It’s in the flight path so you will see many planes flying overhead.

This is one of the best Marriott properties I have visited. It is modern and clean like many of the newer ACs, Alofts, Residence Inns etc. However, added features really made a difference. There are 2 great hotels, including a cool rooftop bar. The restaurant in the lobby has a very nice breakfast offering both a la carte and buffet! The location is great, very walkable area for shopping, restaurants, bars etc. All of that said, my only reason I am writing this review is DIEGO and all the other great AC Hotel Wynwood staff at the reception desk! They were so awesome and accommodating; a real pleasure to interact with. Each one of them was quick to offer a smile and super helpful recommendations. Diego left a lasting impression with his professionalism and good nature. BIG BIG BIG BIG UP TO DIEGO! Thank you for making the stay for my friends and I very very enjoyable!!!!!!! Whenever we are in the area we will be staying at the AC Hotel Wynwood.

We have titanium statues and Freddy was phenomenal. The staff was grade A and took care of our needs. The area the Hotel is located is excellent it has everything you need nearby from exclusive shops to large box stores. Plus for us the restaurants in the area are some of the most mouth watering establishments in all of Miami.

Nice hotel. Large rooms, nice view. Good breakfast, reasonably priced. Nice staff. The location is good, close to the airport, downtown and Miami Beach. The dinner menu is also ok. However, some things in our room were broken: The toilet seat, the roll curtain and some power outlets. Would come again.

We were offered this hotel when our flight canceled on 4/22/24 and glad we did. After my family and roughly 11 others arrived, we were greeted by a very patient front desk clerk, Sheryl. With everyone being frustrated with our unexpected canceled flight, rather than Sheryl herself be frustrated, she explained the process with the airline to the whole group and had everyone prepared to get the info needed to expedite the checkin process. I failed to say this was going on at 12:45am. Sheryl is exceptional and a committed employee. Please do what’s necessary to keep her on her staff. Outstanding work!

Everyone was great, but the Brazilian woman in the restaurant was one of the BEST and most memorable people I have met in my entire life. I teach customer service for a living and she could not have been warmer, kinder, and more attentive to everyone in the dining room. Even our kids adored her! I teach customer service for a living and this woman sets an example like none I’ve ever seen. My husband and I were there a year ago, and we actually remembered her for being so amazing! Please tell her that the families from Key West will always remember her! We’ll be back for sure ! Best, Elisa Levy

It's always a great experience at this hotel. I stay here every few months for work. I appreciate the support from the staff, special acknowledgment to Sherly. She goes beyond the call and her professionalism is positively is contagious. Thanks again!

It was a wonderful experience being greeted by Shelly. She was kind professional and very pleasant.Roof top restaurant was amazing. All of the staff I encountered were awesome! Main restaurant has a pretty amazing cocktail menu for the “Elite”

Shelly kicks butt!!! Yes the hotel is great, love the entire facility and my favorite is the rooftop/pool! Now back to Shelly, her service was amazing, it was great to see her in the waving when we returned, she checked us in and was so welcoming. She was calm under pressure, assisted guest quickly and always with a smile! We loved the property, location and we could not have asked for better service from Shelly and the rest of the staff!

Recommended for lovers of the beach nearby, far from the crowd and ideal for the pool on the top floor with beauty for the view looking at the Caribbean Sea, so this option is very valid to spend a weekend and several more days or a week romantic

Newly renovated, so the interior is in great condition. Rooms are small, ocean front doesn't have a balcony but city view does. That makes little sense. Front desk staff was mildly ok, felt like they would have rather been somewhere else. Staff recognized status on check-in but nightly upgrade award was denied by corp. Daily destination fee is a rip, provides little to no value. On site restaurant was fine but M club was disappointing. No real snacks or drinks other than soda, coffee and tea. Nothing really fun to do close by but its ok to use as a jumping point for a night for a cruise.

My family and I are enjoying an amazing experience here in Miami. The staff at AC hotel are the best, Freddy at the front desk is absolutely outstanding and having been to a lot of Marriot Hotels as a Bonvoy member, he takes the time to listen, explain and finds the best value solution. He made our stay a 15 over 10.

Our group booked the AC Hotel Wynwood and it couldn't have been more perfect. This was a corporate trip, and the hotel had everything we needed. Between the rooftop dinner party to the last-minute meeting rooms. All of our expectations were met and exceeded. Shoutout to Daniel & Emely for all their help during our stay.

hotel_name: Homewood Suites by Hilton Miami-Airport/Blue Lagoon
review_text: The hotel was in the perfect location for me. My goal was to have a nice, clean hotel with an airport shuttle and not to far from downtown Miami. This hotel provided all of that plus great customer service! When I'm back in town I would definitely stay at this property again!

It is our five year anniversary and we were a little nervous to leave the kids at first. I have to say this has been the best anniversary staycation so far Freddy at the front desk and all the other staff at the front desk were so welcoming and thoughtful. They wished us well. Gave us complimentary drinks and we couldn’t be happier Felix at the bar mixed a wonderful drink had great stories to share and was incredibly attentive I loved the truffle fries The staff at the roof top bar always had a smile and were ready to serve Usually I find hotel rooms in Florida very warm and stuff The room was freezing cold! The bed was very comfortable and the shower had great hot water I also loved that there is a small fridge that kept our drinks very cold All in all would recommend

“My time at AC Hotel Miami Wynwood was truly unforgettable! The sleek, modern design and vibrant energy of the hotel perfectly captured the essence of Wynwood. A special shoutout to Jamila at the front desk, whose warm welcome and genuine hospitality set the tone for my entire stay—she made me feel right at home. And a big thank you to Dixon, the security officer, who was always friendly and attentive, ensuring guests felt safe and well cared for. From the stunning rooftop pool with its breathtaking Miami skyline views to the exceptional service from every staff member, every detail of my stay was perfect. I can’t wait to return!”

I like to stay in this area, and this time decided to try a new hotel… and was better than I expected! From cleaning to breakfast and all the staff, all great! They are always available to help us anytime and i would like to highlight the wonderful work of Jamina at front desk and Daniella at breakfast.

Great hotel, Solomon at the reception was very kind with us. He was very attentive to our requests and the check in was very smooth. He also offered us water which is very appreciative since it’s hot outside. 100% recommand this hotel and you can have your Marriott points, since it’s part of the Marriott program.

I visited your motel and stayed one day prior to going on a cruise to the Bahamas. The day that I stayed, I met one of your workers who is very sweet, polite and helpful even though I did not speak Spanish, she showed me how to translate told me her name was Mary and showed me the way to the pool Area. I asked her where she was from. She said Columbia and told me her last name was Luz that evening I seen her again in the elevator and immediately opened my translator when she spoke and she was asking how my state was and if there was anything that I needed . I rate my time at your facility. With the highest mark! All the staff was wonderful and helpful, and I will be visiting again in the future.

Love the customer service and front desk was very helpful s especially the front desk attendant Georgy ! Very knowledgeable and friendly, definitely will be coming back to this hotel again. The rooftop view was beautiful and the pina colda the bar made was delicious!

The woman who works in night shift, Sherly, has been the most helpful front desk person. I’ve been to many hotels but Sherly always provides the best customer service and the best service I have ever have. She has been so helpful throughout my stay

I’ve returned to this establishment once more and felt compelled to write a review about my previous stay. I’ll be sure to add another review after my current trip. I had previously submitted a review, but it never got published. I’m not sure what happened, but I’m excited to share my positive feedback and experience about my stay now. There were so many moving parts and such an effortless group tandem that made my stay exceptional. Roneca, Shelly, and Alex were among the amazing crew members who welcomed me during my last stay. They made sure that all my accommodations and requests were met. They also provided expert advice, tips, and recommendations for good food and places to visit. I can’t thank them enough for making me feel welcome and appreciated. I definitely recommend this establishment and look forward to returning.

The hotel is very good. Rooms are big and spacious, but have little closet spaces, which really did not bothered me. The service all around the hotel is really excellent. Patricia, on the front desk, Carla, at the restaurant, and the housekeeping team always have a smile and kind words to deal with the guests.

I booked this last minute at a very good price for one. I had never stayed at a Rosen property before this and I was sceptical for the price. On arrival I had been allocated a room far from the reception area, this wasn't an issue to me but next to me was a large booking of 25 rooms all being put in the same area, the lady behind reception asked if I was okay with this to which I said I wouldn't mind. She must have seen the look of worry on my face. She then tapped away and said we have block c floor 4. This was perfect for me. I got to my room and was treated by a lovely cool, clean, spacious room. For the price I paid I was more then happy. The beds are soooooo comfortable, the pillows I need these in my own home. There was a fridge and microwave in the room with a coffee machine, some paper cups and coffee for the morning - this was restocked daily too. The towels was changed daily too. The room was dark, but this was more to do with the dark wood furniture but as I didn't spend too much time in the room it didn't bother me. The lite bites shop on site was a little pricey but nothing more then expected for an onside shop. It was well stocked, the pizza they do is lovely too. First night I just didn't want to wander to far. 3 pools, one was out of use due to works being completed when I was there but this wasn't an issue. The work started around 9am and I didn't hear anything in the evening when returning after a full day out. The hotel is a short walk from CVS, Wallgreens and a number of restaurants. There is loads to pick from. On the door step there is wonder works, and a short walk to icon park. The daily transport to universal was good too, pre book the previous day and just hop on. The way back was a little hit and miss to be fair but an user was around 6-8 $ I will definitely return to this hotel

The hotel is well located, close to Wynwood and Design District: within walking distance, a Target and many food outlets are nearby. The view is correct. The bedding and pillows are soft and comfortable. On arrival we had a booking problem (because of our agency), Claire - the receptionist - was very responsive and kind. Our problem was quickly resolved. The downside would be that the street is a little too noisy, quite early in the morning. Sensitive to noise, arm yourself with earplugs. We recommend this hotel anyway.

I’ve stayed at this hotel years ago but now it looks and feel like a complete different property. I can’t say enough good things not only about the elegant new tasteful decor but also the staff that made our stay so special. Susana Reyes on the sales team is a super star. She is not only extremely accommodating when it comes to clients requests but also thoughtful and extremely professional. So happy to see many familiar faces I knew still working here. Breakfast is great as well dinner if you don’t want to leave the hotel. Check out the stunning new bar. I would continue to come back here anytime I’m in the Miami area. Keep in mind the offer a phenomenal complementary shuttle service with live updates of where the shuttle is. Highly recommend this hotel.

Great location for couples and if you want to get out and about to see things. Lots of restaurants etc on the doorstep. Pool was great and got lots of sun in the afternoon. The room wasn’t spotless on arrival but when we mentioned it they rectified straight away. Restaurant on the 7th floor was super and lovely 5-7 for sunset and drinks

The hotel is located at the beginning of the whynwood district, a bit decentralized 15 minutes by taxi to get to the coolest areas of downtown, but this also makes it very quiet to sleep at night, in the immediate vicinity 7/8 minutes walk there is a beautiful shopping center where you can find everything. The hotel is newly renovated very well run friendly and friendly staff. The rooms are very large and clean, very large bathroom with showers with huge cabin. On each floor there is a fresh water and ice dispenser. Absolutely recommended!!!

The hotel was clean, well decorated, and the staff were amazing. Will definitely book again when in Miami. The local area was filled with shopping, restaurants, grocery stores, and general shopping. Not a far taxi ride to local beaches. Very happy with all amenities.

What a guest experience! From the first meeting at reception to departure to the airport. Excellent recommendations for breakfast, at the French bakery Marie’s and dinner at the unbeatable Tap 42. It serves the world's best IPA, Jai Alai from Cigar City Brewing in Tampa. The rooms were amazing.

EXCELLENT hotel. Boutique feel, very nice rooms and ambience inside and out, plus a really nice rooftop bar/pool. They even have food there, up top and a very nice restaurant on the first floor. Breakfast buffet (pretty basic) but we ordered food from the kitchen and both breakfasts were absolutely great. Staff was excellent, location so convenient to local dining and shopping. We would DEFINITELY stay there again!

I enjoyed the ADA upgrade to a suite room. It felt like the planning of the space was well thought out. As a designer, these are things that I pay close attention to. Since I'm an early riser, I wanted to take advantage of the empty pool but I was disappointed that there weren't any towels for me to dry off. The location was perfect for the price and I think there was missing patio furniture. Which didn't make a ton of sense. I liked the art work in the lobby as they were from local artist. Some of which I know personally. I do wish they had regular complimentary water in my room.

Room was nice, the shower was great, but street noise and noise from the elevator and people in the hall were a constant disruption until well after midnight both nights. SImple horns in the street echoes in the room and normal hallway conversation was clearly audible. You need better soundproofing.

Wonderful, attentive staff. The room was large, modern, spacious, and clean. The room was as quiet as you can expect from a hotel in Miami--there was some noise from cars on the street and music from the clubs, but the hotel itself was quiet. The location was wonderful, within walking distance of everything the design district has to offer. Close to restaurants, clubs, target, anything you need. Would stay here again.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites Miami Wynwood Design District
review_text: Very comfortable stay. Enjoyed its proximity to public transport and getting to the beach. The breakfast staff were on top of everything. Had a great room overlooking the sea. Stayed for 4 nights. Though the pool was cleaned daily, a better job of having additional pool towels were needed.

I have stayed here multiple times and have worked with Daniela and her team to execute events. The hotel is great and Daniela and her team are wonderful and easy to work with. I highly recommend the AC Hotel Miami Wynwood! They take care of business!

Cynthia, the rooftop bartender was very attentive and amazing with my group of friends, helping with tasty drinks and overall great experience for our first time in miami. Definitely this hotel will be our go too as it’s close to everything.

Cynthia at the rooftop restaurant was AMAZING! She was so nice, knowledgeable and made great drinks! Attentive to all our needs! My hubby had the surf and turf (beef and shrimp skewers) that Cynthia recommended. They were so delicious he said he could have eaten two orders!!! Thanks again Cynthia for the great conversation, suggestions and impeccable service!

Staff is excellent! I met Billy at the front desk and he was very helpful and very accommodating. Housekeeping did a great job during my stay. The hotel is next to the design district and just 5 minute walking distance from wynwood, lot of restaurants and shops around. We will be back, thanks Billy for everything,

The pool staff is AMAZING! They took care of us. 10 out of 10 experience! Any time we needed help, they would not hesitate to come over and take care of us. The drinks and food were both great. They continued to check on us the entire time we visited the pool.

My experience with this hotel was very bad. I am a Bonvoy Platinum member and the treatment at the front desk was horrible. The 2 people, a guy and a girl, were very rude. I tried to speak to the manager Jorge and they wouldn't let me. It's incredible that this hotel is part of Bonvoy. Stay away from this hotel.

Cynthia is an exceptional bartender at the AC Hotel. She’s consistently welcoming, offering top-notch customer service with professionalism and friendliness. She remembers preferences, makes perfect recommendations, and handles busy shifts with ease. Her positive attitude and deep knowledge of the menu enhance every experience, making customers feel valued. Cynthia’s teamwork and efficiency are unmatched, and her dedication to hospitality truly stands out. She absolutely deserves recognition for her hard work and commitment.

I had an excellent stay at Hyde Midtown Miami. The room was spacious, comfortable, and beautifully designed—perfect for relaxing after a day in the city. A special shoutout to Renata, who was incredibly nice and helpful throughout my visit. Highly recommend!

I always stay a the Hyde , the hotel has great bed soft and firm, nice big pillows, great customer service at the front desk along with one of the best locations in Midtown Miami. I recommend the Hyde to anyone traveling fir business or for pleasure

Great location in the heart of Midtown that makes you feel the vibrant atmosphere of Miami. Cafes, restaurants and shopping centers a few steps away. The treatment by the staff is amazing and they make you feel at home.

Excellent location, close to restaurants and District Design. Receptionist Claire is very attentive and helped us a lot. Comfortable suite. Ample bathroom. The kitchen lacked dishes and cutlery, but we ordered and brought. I'll be back.

I'm still staying at the hotel, but the first impression was terrible. Starting from the front desk, the attendant was grumpy and did not respond to questions asked (Amazon deliveries/parking) After we entered the room, they called us informing us that they had extra packages from Amazon, which my wife questioned at check-in, as well as asking 3 times about parking and said that I would have to pay every time I entered and left, which was denied when we went out for dinner. The room has good facilities, but the floor (wooden) is dirty enough to say disgusting. For the price, an average of 300 USD per night, I expected much more from this hotel. Room 317 (corner)

During my stay at AC Marriott I had the pleasure of spending some time at the roof bar/resturaunt Elevar located on the rooftop of the hotel. I experienced exceptional service from Cynthia . She was friendly, and accommodating every time I decided tonmake a visit up top. An employee that represents the company like this deserves all the flowers from guest like myself who’s been staying here for 5 week on work related trip. 10/10 stars! Recommend spending time up here the service has been past impeccable. -Zoox

We have just had a wonderful 5 night stay in this stylish hotel and whilst checking in we were upgraded to a suite. The hotel is situated in a classy residential area, with lovely bakery's, restaurants and shops all very close by. The reception staff were all really lovely and helpful, Renata especially who we spoke with quite a lot and she helped us with all our questions. There is a beautiful rooftop pool and hot tub which we used every day. We would highly recommend this hotel and would definitely stay there again should we return to Miami.

Fujam desse hotel. Fujam. I stayed in it from 11 to 16 April 2025. No day, I repeat, no day a cleaning team passed through my room. I was missing toilet paper, I was gonna take the garbage out of my room by myself at night, out of the undue collection of fees on my credit card that I'm still solving. The worst experience of my trip.

Bad experience lived by my wife and daughters. They don't clean the rooms claiming a lack of staff. They didn't even repurpose toilet paper and make undue charges on the card during the morning. When questioned, they claimed to be a caution that had already been made at check-in. Evitem. They are malicious

I always enjoy coming here. This is my 9th time in Miami. I really enjoy going to the Sky Bar. Cynthia at the bar does a fantastic job. Since I'm from Germany and Cynthia speaks German, it's always nice to be able to speak a few words in German. And Cynthia's cocktails always taste excellent. I highly recommend the Sky Bar.

We stayed at Mr. C Coconut Grove last weekend and we loooved it! The place is gorgeous, the rooms are beautiful and super comfortable! Massive thanks to Tabata Delgado, she was so sweet and nice, made us feel right at home. Definitely booking a return trip, cant wait to go back!!

Excellent experience from the welcoming till the departure. All the staff was very friendly and ready to assist you for any matter. We had breakfast in room and a dinner at Bellini. A good experience of the Italian cuisine and an high quality food and beverage overall.

Cynthia was an amazing waitress. It is our 6 month anniversary and she made us feel so special tonight. She even got the cook to write “Happy 6 months” on our dessert. She went over and beyond. This was our first time visiting Elevar from out of town and we will definitely be here again.

Good hotel for a a night stop over before a cruise. Location is a good distance between the cruise port and airport so easy to get to both by taxi. Rooms were clean and spacious and staff were lovely and helpful. There is a small pool on the roof which is great to get over the jet lag check out was 12 noon which was a great

This is the second time my wife and I stayed at Mr. C Coconut Grove. The first time was about 5 years ago for a wedding. Mr. C was relatively new at that time so we gave them a pass when it came to the mediocare service. We ended up staying here again for another wedding. Upon arrival we were greeted by friendly staff and the welcome drinks were a nice touch. Upon entering our room, we paid for an upgraded view room and it was just a view of the church across the street and the slightest view of the bay. The room also smelled awful like BO. The smell stayed in the room the entire time. The noise at night when trying to sleep was very loud, you could easily hear people walking around/coughing/throwing up in the other room. To top it off, we were trapped in the tiny elevator with about 15 or so people with no cell service for over 20 minutes! The front staff handled this very poorly. They never called the fire dept, we finally got through on our own dialing via SOS. You could clearly see on the cameras we were trapped and most of us are now traumatized by this experience. After the fire dept got us out, NO ONE, not one manager was there, no one with waters or apologizing to us. In fact they made us go down the service staff stairs in order to not disrupt the event going on at the time. Just atrocious response to a very scary situation. It was finally asknowledged by the front desk during check out and eventually they gave us a $200 credit towards our bill. To me this does not suffice the damage this has caused both me and my wife along with the other guests. There was never a follow up phone call or a personal management staff apologizing to us upon check out. It just seemed considering the severity, we were just simply brushed off and no one showed they cared. Overall, for such a reputable brand, this was a huge let down and I have lost my faith in the Mr. C brand.

All very well. It is not a luxury hotel because for example it has no breakfast, but it is super well located to walk around the place. It has many places for breakfast (like Marie) where you can also eat rich savoury things, the Italian restaurant Salumeria and another Italian ,Pasta e basta and many more. There are also many places to shop, cheap, medium and very expensive(for all tastes). The hotel rooms are very comfortable, clean and the services like swimming pool and so on are perfect. At the reception is CLAIRE who we found a charm. Very attentive, polite and well with Spanish (she is French).

I've just come back from 10 days at the Aventura and would return! It's great base for exploring. You can walk through the pool area to the entrance of Volcano Bay which takes less than 5 minutes and City Walk, Universal and IOA are a short walk, bus or water taxi shuttle away (walk across the road to Sapphire Falls for the water taxi they are so frequent and easy with an amazing view along the way and you also go through a security check here so miss all that at Universal.) We ended up using this more often than not! The food at Bar 17 is really good and the views are beautiful. You can catch the sun set and then fireworks from Magic Kingdom and Epcot in the distance. We enjoyed the pizza in the Urban Pantry and the only other things we ate there was breakfast which we didn't enjoy, but easy enough to jump over to city walk and grab a yummy breakfast from Cinnabon etc/or order something from Uber on those days with late starts 🙂 City Walk also has some great options for food in the evenings if you don't want to go too far. The staff at reception were lovely and the room was more than decent for the two of us, the bed was comfortable and we had a great view. If you miss the cleaner (we had a DND sign on the door shortly whilst we got ready) you miss them for that day and they are scheduled every other day so bare this in mind. We also found the hotel so peaceful after a day at the parks which we really appreciated! An Uber to a base Disney park was always a reasonable price and we then tended to use the free Disney transport to go between parks and disney springs. Heads up, if heading to MK to watch the fireworks you cannot get an Uber directly from the park and need to get the monorail or boat to the transportation center which has crazy ques after the fireworks, so worth hanging around and getting some rides in untill those die down.

Nice place where it is quiet and where you can enjoy nice eateries within walking distance. Rather, it feels European. Hotel was fine, we arrived early but could enjoy the poolside sunbed to process the long flight. The food at the pool was also fine and the breakfast was fortunately not American 😉... so no plastic wrapped cookies but a decent buffet with a very welcoming host. Highly recommended! Unfortunately, Trump no longer makes it pleasant to travel to USA... You feel the tense atmosphere at the airport... you no longer feel welcome there...
Beautiful hotel, amazing pool w/ fantastic views, great service (including nightly turn down service, valet, pool service, front desk), excellent location. Can't wait to return!
Beautiful place, and Kimberly and Claire at the front desk helping me made the stay perfect. Returning soon. Can't wait.

This is a retro themed resort with 2 large pools, a lazy river, hot tubs, bowling alley, amazing gym, sandy ‘beach’, Starbucks, ice cream shop, and a couple of cafeteria like restaurants. Shuttle service runs every 10-15 minutes to the Universal parks/City Walk. The room we stayed in was a standard 2 queen. The beds were very comfortable. Only downside - 2 pillows per bed. I like 2 pillows just for me, and since each bed was fully occupied with family, I had to just deal with having only 1 pillow. The check in line was a bit long - even though I had checked in on line prior to arrival. Checking out was easier - quick email or text confirmation. There’s only a small refrigerator and packet style coffee maker in the room - no microwave. However, there’s 4 microwaves down in the dining area that were available (just a tad inconvenient imo). There’s a $26/night self parking charge, and the room keys allow for in/out privileges - however the gates seemed kind of glitchy (wouldn’t quickly read the room keys - and so the line leaving the parking lot was slow). They charge $14 for a ‘souvenir’ float for the lazy river. However, there’s an air station so we bought inexpensive floats from Walmart and just inflated them onsite. The place is pretty big - and very busy (the pool and lazy river was almost like bumper cars occasionally) It’s fairly well maintained and the staff were friendly. They offer Florida resident or military discounts. We thoroughly enjoyed our stay.

The front desk lady was really nice she welcomed us with a smile and recommended us many places I think her name was Deneb thank you for the nice experience🤗🤗🤗🤗🤗🤗🤗🤗🤗😝🤗🤗🤗🤗🤗🤗🤗🤗🤗🤗🤗🤗🤗🤗🤗🤗🤗🤗🤗🤗🤗🤗🤗🤗🤗🤗🤗🤗🤗🤗😝🤗😝😝🤗🤗🤗🤗🤗🤗🤗🤗🤗🤗🤗🤗🤗🤗🤗🤗🤗🤗🤗🤗🤗🤗🤗🤗🤗🤗🤗🤗🤗🤗🤗
Top notch service, incredibly clean, impeccable features from years past when human interaction was priority! Classy, almost a throwback in terms of how well they treat the customer.

Lovely room, beautiful hotel. The hotel is not only beautiful, but we never heard other guests, so great quality of sleep. Staff was professional and knowledgeable. Perfect location for our needs on this visit. We'll definitely return!
Some of the best service I have ever experienced. They let us check in early, always checked if we needed water before we headed out, helped us with reservations, ect. Would highly recommend!!

One of the best hotel experiences we have every had! Miami. Mr. C in Coconut Grove is stylish and modern. The location is perfect for a quiet getaway from the busy city and we loved that it is walkable to several shops and restaurants. The service was warm and personal, and the welcome Bellini was a great touch. Our room was amazing, the style and comfort were more than expected. The room is full of all the necessary amenities and more? The mini bar was well stocked with a variety of alcoholic and non-alcoholic beverages, it also included snacks and even Mr. C branded merchandise. The staff even provided us with a hand written thank you note which included complementary gourmet chocolates. The rooftop restaurant has beautiful views of the bay and our breakfast was delicious. Mr. C Coconut Grove is a must try hotel and now one of our favorites in Miami.
Beautiful hotel in a beautiful location. The staff is fabulous and the views from the rooftop pool and bar are spectacular. We loved how everything in the hotel was unique and branded for Mr. C.
The room Is beautiful! It’s a luxury to stay here! And I felt really safe! The place has gorgeous views of Miami, and I loved the lobby area!
Great layover in MCO at the Florida hotel. All the staff was really great, Greta food in the restaurant and my room was nice and clean and AC worked great. They also have a great huge pool!!

I had an amazing stay at Mr. C Miami in Coconut Grove. The hotel is beautifully designed with a chic, nautical aesthetic that feels both upscale and relaxing. Staff was amazing and very attentive sometimes felt overwhelming. Rooftop pool was so awesome with great poolside service. I would definitely stay here again!

I have to say that this is not my first time staying in this property, but it's the first time that I found the staff being so friendly and nice. That for me was a great thing. BUT, and it is a big but, the property is starting to feel old and not taken care of. For what once was, such a modern hotel, it really feels dated. Not because of the design, but because it hasn't been maintained well. I would stay here again of course, but because I really like the area of midtown and how close it is to the Design District, but be prepared to feel a bit underwhelmed.

hotel_name: Signia By Hilton Orlando - An Official Walt Disney WorldR Hotel
review_text: This hotel gets better each time we come with our friends and family. We take an annual trip to spend time and La Luce is always a must go! We had a Cabana by the lazy river and the kids have an amazing time watching TV in the Cabana and swimming in the lazy river. The team and management is top notch and the service is 5 stars.
Wonderful boutique hotel. Great communication, service and fun vibe. Bellini for dinner is a must with amazing views and service.

I'm definitely adding this to my list of favorite hotels! From the moment I arrived, someone was there to open my car door and help with my bags. Check-in was a breeze, and I was welcomed with a refreshing cold beverage. The front desk staff was incredibly polite and professional - honestly, even the way they handed back my credit card with both hands felt so thoughtful and warm. Now, the room... absolutely luxurious! The Jonathan Adler toiletries and the serene blue decor were perfect. The lights had dimmers, which made it so easy to unwind and read before bed. They also offer a lovely turndown service with water and chocolates - such a nice touch of luxury. The rooftop pool was fantastic with stunning views. My only real gripe was that the poolside service could’ve been more consistent, and I wish the breakfast menu had a bit more variety. But other than that, this place is a solid 5/5!!! :)
Excellent hotel across the board. Great value and service. Morgan at the front desk was awesome! Dinner in restaurant was a bit disappointing. Love the hotel and will be back!
Beautiful space and superb guest relations, the location can’t be beat. Our group thoroughly enjoyed the rooftop bar and ambiance

Fantastic location in the very heart of Midtown Miami. Great room, great staff, from the Front Desk (Claire was awesome) to the Valets. You have so much shopping and local restaurants to choose from all within a few blocks plus the high end Fashion District is just about 4 blocks away. Everything is within easy walking distance. Very vibrant, hip area. Totally recommended as a must stay. We are returning soon. Also the Hyde Midtown and all the stores and restaurants we saw and visited are dog friendly. Literally everyone living there walk their dogs a be lot.
Great location! They buckle and dime you for everything. Very overpriced food and drinks. $26 for a glass of basic wine.

Very nice, new hotel in convenient location near Miami design district. Outstanding front desk staff who were kind, supportive, knowledgeable and helpful. Giselle when we checked in was terrific! Beautiful roof top views, bar prices a bit high, pool was nice. Fitness room needs some TLC. No Hand sanitizer, air conditioning appeared to be less than ideal, TV Missing and room was very narrow. Would definitely return and would recommend this hotel

Mr C is a wonderful property with best breakfast in town. Il Giardino is truly the best kept secret in Coconut Grove. The food is consistently delicious and the service is by far the best in the grove. Evian, Christian and Adolfo are always very attentive and extremely detailed oriented.

My overall experience went well. It was a nice, clean hotel. The only thing I did not like was that the hotel did not offer room service, so it forced me to have to go out to eat all the time. There was spots within walking distance from the hotel that I could eat at, but it would've been better if I didn't have to leave the hotel at all.

I'm doing this review a little differently. Instead of waiting until the end of the trip, I’ll update it daily as I experience something noteworthy. Day 1 First impressions are very nice. It’s a cool little boutique hotel in a nice part of Coconut Grove. The lobby was slightly odd, as the first "counter" you see is a pastry counter. Just past it to the left is the front desk. The service is very friendly and attentive. The woman at the front desk was quick to check me in, with an upgrade (yay), and offered me water and a Bellini. I took both! The only issue was I had to fill out information on an iPad with details I thought they’d already have—address, phone number, email, etc. My room was on the first floor, which I thought was fine, but the view was a little low, as I realized when I went to the Bellini Restaurant on the top floor. Not terrible, but I’d definitely ask for a higher floor next time. The room itself is very nice—modern without being cold. It features a nice wood desk, dresser, and closets, an impressive minibar, and some snacks. There are also sunglasses and hats, which can be purchased. A neat touch I've never seen before. Even a foam roller in the closet shows great attention to detail. There is free and paid Wi-Fi; the free option seems fast enough for Zoom and everything else I need. I was hungry, so I went upstairs to the Bellini Restaurant. Like the front desk, the service was excellent. I had a chicken sandwich that was very tasty. It came with fries, which were great—actually, some of the best fries I’ve ever had. I had dinner in my room: a different chicken sandwich (name forgotten) with tomato and avocado. Very good. Tiramisu for dessert, which was very good as well. The service again was excellent. The fridge in the room is full of alcohol, so it’s hard to fit a water or other drink in there. This is the only negative I’ve experienced with the room so far. Day 2 Had lunch in-room today. Cheeseburger with fries. Very good, and, as usual, the service was excellent. A quick issue was resolved by the front desk. The service here really is impressive—everyone seems genuinely interested in helping you have a great time at the hotel. Found one small negative: the TV is not on a mount that swings. It would have been nice when sitting on the couch, but it’s not a major issue. Something else that was a little weird is that the Wi-Fi kicks you off after 24 hours and requires you to re-establish the connection. Not a big deal, but it’s something I’ve never experienced at other hotels. Just got a courtesy call from the front desk asking how my stay has been so far and if I need anything else. They also asked when I was checking out and if I needed any transportation. Very impressive service. Had dinner, which was the club sandwich and some beer. Great, like the last meal and service. Day 3 Check-out was quick. The way they had me view the receipt was quite nice: on a leather-bound pad of some kind. They asked a few questions about how much I enjoyed my stay, if I needed transportation, etc. I really enjoyed my time here and highly recommend this hotel to anyone looking for a nice place to stay in Coconut Grove.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: Great hotel, location and staff. This was our second time staying here and it did not disappoint. The rooms are modern and clean. The breakfast has a large variety of items to choose from. The hotel is walking distance to lots of great restaurants, short ride from the airport, cruise port or Miami. The metro is also right by the hotel for easy access to Miami. Will definitely choose this hotel again when staying in Miami.

Perfectly situated for a 1 night stay with us dining at a nearby restaurant with some friends. Rooms spacious and comfortable. Intimate pool area and great pool bar. Even though we didn’t eat at the pool bar, I’d return to have a burger. It’s cooked fresh on a grill and looked and smelt amazing. Front desk very helpful locating a bag we stupidly left behind. Thank you for that. Definitely recommended.

As a travel advisor, I have worked with this particular hotel a lot in setting up rooms pre-cruise for many of my clients, both with individual travelers and with large groups. I can say that the quality of customer service at this location, specifically by the hotel management and staff, is by far one of the top in the industry. They are responsive, helpful for specific client needs, and accommodating to special circumstances for each of my clients. This is hospitality at its finest! Specific shout outs to John Gunter, Rooms Operations Manager, Bertha Crucett, Director of Sales & Marketing, Lilian Lopez, Sales Executive, and Andrew Sirota, Sales Manager.

I gave it a five because there were no deficiencies, but the travelers need to know this is a boutique hotel that lacked some of the amenities of larger properties, but the highlights are a rooftop pool looking out over the bay. Bellini’s is a top-tier restaurant where you can have breakfast in the morning and look out at the water as well as fine dining in the evening the gym is small, but highly functional and there is a cool Outdoor café patio area upon entry. The rooms are quite small, but well appointed.

Celebrated my Birthday at AC Hotel Miami Wynwood. It was a solo trip, The whole Staff (Anya, Fyannah, Randy, Andrew, Yusi) so many names I forgot to mention went above and beyond to make my birthday very special. I would recommend staying at this hotel. My room was clean, shower head was amazing. I had a great view to the city from my room as well. The rooftop bar and views from the roof were beautiful. Definitely will be back to stay here when I travel to Miami.

And the second time I stay in this hotel is always preserves the quality! This time I was surprised by the attention of all the receptionists and especially “Claire” who helped me with all the problems I had and giving me wonderful tips from Miami. Important to say of the tranquility that Claire receives and resolves the impasse giving us due safety and importance to its clients! Human experience is still above everything! Thank you, Claire!

Another amazing trip to Miami. Skip south beach and head to Coconut Grove. This hotel does NOT have an employee who does not have smile all the time, ask you how your day was and ask you if you need anything. Everyone at the front desk is amazing but Roberto rocks!!! Houskeeeping is always on point and how can you forget the staff upstairs at Bellini and the food. We cant wait to come back to visit our daughter living there (she offered for us to stay with her but lets be honest the Chocolates at Mr. C are better 😂 )

Excellent hotel and location for universal. We were on the 16th floor (top) with theme park view and it was stunning. Room was perfect beds comfortable and good sized shower. Food in hotel is also good, especially the wok station. The hotel does have free transportation for universal and epic, however the garden walk to city walk is an easy 15 minute stroll and quicker as you miss the long queues at city walk security. There is also the water taxi at the hotel,over the road (sapphire falls) which is also free and another alternative option. You can also use the pool at sapphire falls which has a water slide. If we return to Orlando and universal in the future then we wouldn’t hesitate to return to this hotel.

Had an amazing stay. Hotel is well located mid town. Amenities are great and love the pool and fitness. The best of all is Claire at the front desk. She was able to recommend a great restaurant and a nice bar.
Excellent, place to stay, great rooms, very responsive and attentive front desk. Claire was great. Only thing to consider is being more clear about the term "Kitchette" there is only a microwave.
Location was excellent the room was clean and the staff friendly. I will definitely go again when traveling for business or personal.

We stayed at this hotel for 4 nights, it was an unforgettable experience, the hotel is located in a very nice area of Miami and well connected to the most interesting places to see. The staff is very kind, the room was perfect, the bed very comfortable, the bathroom spacious and the room very bright with a fantastic view of the bay. The restaurant is amazing, you eat divinely and all the staff is professional and competent. We will definitely be back and straconsiglio!

Mr. C has been great. The rooms and service has been wonderful. Spent an entire afternoon at the pool with Abel and he provided incredible service! Would definitely come back just to relax at the pool again.

Aventura was in my top 3 hotels at Universal Florida until this stay in Sept 2025. There are 6 check-in stations at the front desk. Only 1 employee named Christina was present to check guests in at 12:05 pm. After 35 minutes of waiting, I was finally able to check-in. I knew that I was early and the room would not be ready. But now the luggage clerk had disappeared. No place to check the luggage. I was looking to visit the park for a few hours and wait for the room to be ready. Those plans when down the drain.

We stayed at Universal Aventura for 6 nights during September. We opted for an Uber from MCO airport to the hotel which was a 30 minute drive. Upon arrival, we checked in with a friendly receptionist and then redeemed our park tickets at the nearby desk. Our room was on the 4th floor with a slight view of the pool and the top of Volcano Bay The room was huge with 2 double beds and a separate sink which I really liked. Room functions such as temperature, TV, lights etc were all via an iPad. We tried to check out via the iPad but this didn’t work The room was a little noisy with traffic, but nothing major We opted for the hotel breakfast one morning (Urban Pantry) but this was basic food at high prices. We went to Walmart to grab bagels etc - there are facilities to have your own breakfast such as microwaves and toasters. This is really good The hotel is within walking distance to Volcano Bay with a private walkway. There are free shuttles to all Universal parks. You can also cross the road and use the water taxi from Sapphire Falls We really enjoyed our stay here and would definitely stay here again

While staying at Sapphire Falls I decided to explore Aventura since it was conveniently just a few minutes walk away. The first thing I noticed was the modern interior and quiet atmosphere in the lobby. The pool area is nothing exotic, there is a poolside bar. The elevators are modern and have a digital pad. The floor for the roof top bar will not be on display as an option in the elevator until opening hours 4 or 5 pm. Bar 17 bistro serves Asian fusion fare. Another design element I noticed while in the elevator and the doors opened on a floor, were the room numbers placed on the exterior wall frames of each room entry. Very easy to read and find your room with ease. Im sure the rooms are equally modern and comfortable. The lobby has a Starbucks and a gift shop that has a dressing room. Gift shop at Sapphire Falls does not have a dressing room. See my review for Sapphire for more.

Whilst visiting from the UK on a short solo trip to attend Universal Orlando Resort's Halloween Horror Nights, I enjoyed a week at this prime value hotel. The room was well presented overall, and offered a convenient on-property location. I enjoyed walking to the theme parks, whilst also having the option of a bus to CityWalk and water taxi next door at Sapphire Falls. The availability of dining at the hotel was great for the price and the pool was fantastic. Service from all team members was wonderful, and the tower structure was very much enjoyed for great views over the Orlando area and less walking inside the resort. Some small improvements that I'd love to see though, is a hand towel rail or hook (not having one was surprisingly frustrating, especially given the bi-daily housekeeping), hooks by the door to hang rain jackets, I wasn't a fan of the tablet controlling the TV and lights, and would much prefer a remote and switches. The rooftop bar is lovely, but there's no covered seating that isn't considered 'serviced,' which meant I was asked to either sit in the rain or leave if I wasn't ordering anything. And I think daily housekeeping should be a staple of any on-property hotel, regardless of whether it's considered 'value' or not. Improvements aside, for the price per night, I thought it was a good stay overall and I'd be open to staying here again.

Great location with shuttle or boat to parks , and app 20mn walk if you prefer We like that pool area which was never too busy and had poolside bar Also the convenient food court with a good selection of food and the addition of a Starbucks was a bonus for us Fabulous view from rooftop bar and reasonable price for drinks and food We were on 11th floor with great views all round

This was the 2nd time we’ve stayed at this resort and both times have been fabulous. I didn’t get a chance to write a review on the conclusion of my first visit but I wanted to write one after this trip. The hotel is beautiful and being an onsite hotel you access to the Universal Transportation for all of the parks including Epic. The Volcano Bay walk way is only a 2 min walk, the distance is very minimal. Check-in was very easy and were given an upgrade to a corner room which is slightly larger than your standard room. The tablet in the room controls everything we loved it! The room had a good view of the parks and wonderful Sapphire Falls resort. Rooms were serviced every other day, which was great for us. Everything was clean and immaculate. The food offerings are great and every time we had something from the Urban Pantry it was very tasty. The robots are a great and novel addition to the overall aesthetic of the resorts. Very pleased we got to stay here a 2nd time. Very nice resort highly recommend!
Location is great and service good. However, I was looking forward to using the jacuzzi and it was jacuzzi closed for multiple days of my stay.

AC Hotels Miami Wynwood was fantastic experience. Isys and Alex checked us in and Jamala checked us out. All 3 were friendly and accommodating. Jamala even showed me a feature on my suitcase which I didn't know existed. Here are the reasons for my 5 Star Review 1. Staff - Staff were all nice. The 3 mentioned in the intro were my highlight 2. Food - Breakfast was really good in the lobby. If you get the fiery egg croissant do make sure you get the sauce on the side. It was super hot. Elevar on the roof has great burgers which they grill on a grill by the ba right in front of you. 3. Cleanliness - Beds, room, and bathroom were clean 4. Euro decor - Not too overly complicated but sleek 5. Location - 2 blocks from the Midtown shopping center and there are hundreds of restaurants in walking distance. The cruise port is a 10-15 drive. The airport was less than 20 minutes by car 6. Rooftop - The views were gorgeous 7. Gym - Clean! Nice amount of equipment for a hotel. 8- Bikes - The property has bikes to rent for sightseeing. If you're in the Art District or Miami and need a hotel look no further.

What a wonderful hotel and staff. In particular I wish to praise Manager Jonathan Paul who has been especially kind, considerate, efficient and outstanding. He immediately established a personal connection and was amazingly responsive. We stay here all the time! Stephen P. Haber, Ann Jackler

Pros: Strikes a nice balance between staying close to the action and not costing as much as other Universal properties; pleasant modern vibe; geared toward adults Cons: Parking costs, ever-increasing room costs, a multitude of room issues made recent stays stressful and frustrating, overall lapse in maintenance Once (not too long ago) one of my favorite places to stay because of its closeness to the Universal parks and affordability, costs continue rising while quality slides, slides, and slides some more. I am questioning whether or not I'll return for future reservations I booked long ago- a decision that will pain me because I love being able to walk across to Sapphire Falls, hop on a water taxi, and be at City Walk in ten minutes. On the plus side, Aventura is aimed at adults, meaning this place is quiet at night. Across many stays, I have never been woken up by doors slamming and children running up and down the halls. However, the small and minimalist rooms force compromises, such as painfully tiny refrigerators and very few drawers for clothing. A couple spending more than a few days here will likely struggle with storage limitations. For the second time in a row, I was given a room with a television that kept shutting off without warning. Unlike last time when I allowed engineering to spend four days attempting to fix the problem, this time I requested a different room. Unfortunately, the new room had an HVAC system that wasn't functioning properly, so I had to change rooms a second time. This got in the way of me going to one of the parks on my first day because I spent three hours dealing with engineering while unpacking, packing, unpacking, packing, and unpacking again. The fact that the property only refunded me $100 for this major inconvenience says much of its desire to provide exceptional customer service. The Aventura really needs to re-think its in-room technology- most of which is controlled by a bedside tablet. The system of controlling the television (when it works) and most of the room's lighting from a touch screen is unnecessarily complicated and fussy (and I am not one who typically struggles with technology). The lack of a customer-focused approach permeates most of the Aventura experience these days, from outrageous parking costs (even Disney hotels no longer change for parking), to engineering calls taking upwards of 30 minutes for a response, to a front desk that is minimally staffed (one person to check in guests), to broken lobby lighting that hasn't been repaired in years, to housekeeping reduced to once every two days. This property is a perfect example of something that used to be special, ruined by an endless desire to make more money by cutting to the bone while still raising prices.

I only stayed at the Aventura for one night when I came down for Halloween Horror Nights, but I had such a wonderful experience and plan to stay again if I come back for the event next year. Every staff member I interacted with was so lovely and kind, I only wish I could remember more of their names (shout out to bartender Tabitha)! My room was so clean and comfortable, and the tablet that controlled all of the lights, TV, etc allowed me to stream content from YouTube. Aventura also has a super convenient shuttle that runs to/from Universal every 10 or so minutes all the way up to like 1AM (pretty sure I caught it to go back to the hotel at 1:10AM). So glad I stayed here and look forward to returning.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites Miami Wynwood Design District
review_text: We only stayed one night (stay over in Miami following a cruise) and our stay was wonderful. The staff were helpful despite how busy it was when we checked in. We were able to store our luggage so we could have a day at the beach. The room was very comfortable.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites Miami Wynwood Design District
review_text: Stayed for 1 night before our cruise. The facility staff were very nice. It was nice that breakfast was included. I also used their gym facility which was clean and machines are well kept.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites Miami Wynwood Design District
review_text: Eric served us and he was so professional and kind. He helped us with all of our needs. We'll definitely stay here again. The room was very clean. The only criticism I would have is to update the pillows because they were very uncomfortable.

The staff is well trained to provide excellent service. Service is coordinated through the front desk which works well. The restaurant is delightful- attractive great service and food. Well located. Can walk to many shops restaurants etc nearby. Highly recommend.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites Miami Wynwood Design District
review_text: Hotel was very appealing as soon as we walked in. Front desk staff were very kind and helpful. Our room was very clean. We would definitely stay again should we travel to Miami again.

We just spent a week at this hotel and we loved many things about it. The room was spacious, modern, comfortable and the beds were fantastic. You can use the in room tablet to control the lights, TV and air-con, and the room gets lovely and cool after a hot day in the parks. The resort buses are frequent and easy to use - we also did the 5 minute walk to Sapphire Falls to use the water taxi, which is a huge plus. The food at the hotel was good (if a little pricey). A few things that could be improved: the vanity area needs a towel hook or rail, bedside tables needed for all sides of the beds. The water pressure for the shower wasn’t amazing but it did the job & the toiletries provided were good. Room service excellent but downstairs we did encounter a surly/borderline rude employee serving the gelato. Lastly, and something we found odd - we received housekeeping only once in 7 days. On one occasion, we came back after a long day at the parks to find nobody had been again, and so we started to bag up and clear out our room ourselves and someone appeared in the corridor to remove the rubbish. We hadn’t finished and explained we were still clearing out and then would have called down to reception - we explained we’d had no housekeeping. The next morning someone did come, but that was it. We believed it to be bi-daily but it just didn’t happen. All in all, this is a great resort but the lack of some services let it down a little.

The hotel was nice, and we had a great view of the park from our room, but we had one hiccup that brought my experience down. Unfortunately it was after our stay so there was no way to bring it to someone's attention and it was the water taxi. My family stayed for a week, and we kept talking about and seeing the water taxi and how fun it would be to ride if we could(not to mention not having to go through park security and the walk to the parks). We had no idea that we could have if we just walked right across the street. During check in we were told about the busses that ran, but no mention ever of the water taxi. When we were checking out the attendant asked how we liked it and we told her we never got to ride it since we didn't have the opportunity. That's when we started chatting about it and she informed us that Sapphire Falls was a boarding location for it. She apologized that we weren't told, but there was nothing that could be done. On our way out we even looked for signs that indicated as such, but nothing.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites Miami Wynwood Design District
review_text: Excellent attention from everyone and especially Eric!!! Super recommended equal for location, breakfast included and cleanliness

I am pasting my Hotels.com review here as well. THERE WERE BEDBUGS!! We were bit!! It was so dirty!! Even though we put on the "Tidy Up My Room" sign noone came in to clean up the room. The hallways had left over trash on them for days. When we told the front desk about these, especially the bed bugs - they told us they would investigate and get back to us. For 3 days now no one reached out. Horrible stay, horrible hotel. Update: It has now been 5 days, and we still haven’t heard back.

This hotel was fabulous! Check-in was easy and staff was very friendly. We had a room on the 10th floor overlooking Volcano Bay. You could also see Epcot and Magic Kingdom in the far distance so you could see their fireworks at night. Do yourself a favor and request a higher floor in the pink section! The room was nice and modern and everything in the room is controlled by a tablet in the room. There are not nearly as many rooms/people here as the other hotels and were hardly any kids here which was an extra bonus for us. The pool is smaller and quiet but perfect for this hotel. They do play movies at night in the pool area. Not a whole lot of food choices but they had unique choices like wok bowls. Also, it is super easy and convenient to catch the water taxi right next door at Sapphire Falls. Security is at the boat dock so you don’t have to use the big security line at Citywalk and you are dropped off in Citywalk between the entrances to both parks. Not only that but there is a direct path to Volcano Bay that goes under the road and takes you right into the park. We will definitely stay here again as this has been our favorite hotel of any hotel we have stayed at in Orlando/Kissimmee.

Dear guys!!! The ADA platinum suite has been the perfect match for my 6 month experience as a wheelchair user the whole Hyde midtown hotel team has been great with me !!! A special thanks to Rob, Renata, ismael, claire, Kimberly, Billy, Samantha, Henry. All of them has always been available and accommodating. I will be missing them very much. Indeed, I have a very special feeling for them. I feel like I am part of The Hyde midtown hotel family forever after spending so long with all of them. I like them very much and I miss all of them very much. Take care my dear friends of the Hyde midtown hotel family Ben

Stayed at the AC Hotel Miami Wynwood for a quick trip and left feeling pretty neutral. The stay wasn’t terrible, but it also wasn’t memorable. The room was fine overall, though there were some noticeable stains on the door that should’ve been cleaned before check-in. I had requested a higher floor, but neither was accommodated, even though the hotel didn’t seem full. There’s no room service, which was my fault for not checking beforehand, but still a bit of a letdown. Service was polite but unremarkable, and the space itself feels more functional than welcoming. It’s not a place I’d warn anyone away from, but it’s also not one I’d choose again.

Nice clean hotel. Elevators were extremely fast. Staff was very friendly especially Barbie at the bar. The rooms could use some pictures and a little more light in the bath. The iPad controller was easy to use. The rates are good.

After staying here in 2024 we were looking forward to staying here again. Before travelling we had requested a room with a view of the theme parks after having one last time. When we arrived we were told room wasn’t ready and would get a text when the room was ready. Time passed and had not received a text so went back and the room had been ready for a while and our keys had been sat there for a while. Got to the room and no theme park view even though a returning customer . Many times we had to chase housekeeping and sometimes new towels were not left or coffee filled up etc . The call this a budget hotel but with the price they charge it is far from. Bar staff round the pool seem very unhelpful and unfriendly even though drinks prices are steep and still expect a tip. Would definitely think twice before choosing here again

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites Miami Wynwood Design District
review_text: You're front desk was very helpful and very well informed,Mr.Quinto was very helpful to my needs and questions very concerning about our stay and we'll being.Very good front person to have in your establishment.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites Miami Wynwood Design District
review_text: We had a wonderful stay. Quinto is the best!!! He knows what customer service is. He was so helpfull when we wanted to extend our stay. And knowledgeable about the area giving us many valuable tips. He is a treasure

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites Miami Wynwood Design District
review_text: Very nice hotel! The room was good the staff very polite! The location good. The breakfast was horrible!! And with extremely limited choices

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites Miami Wynwood Design District
review_text: Excellent stay, stayed 6 nights and everything flawless. Extraordinary breakfast, lots of options, eggs waffles, bread, sausages, fruits, all freshly made. Fifth, the receptionist, he's the best.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites Miami Wynwood Design District
review_text: Great service! Alberte welcomed us warmly, was so helpful and friendly. Such a great start! She even recommended nearby hotel for drinks. Quinto was also there to make this fun and clearly is a great colleague of Alberte
Very nice boutique hotel situated in a great part of town surrounded by lots of great restaurants and great atmosphere.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites Miami Wynwood Design District
review_text: Abdul and Alberte helped us upon arrival. Such great help. Made our stay felt like home. Would highly recommend this hotel

A very nice and modern hotel in Miami. From the airport it is about 20 minutes to drive. The rooms are very modern. The hotel itself has a restaurant, a roof top bar and a pool. Parking in the in-house underground car park is charged $25 per day.

Mr. C had an amazing service all around. Especially Abel at the pool, and many others. We spent 4 days there, and every time they were very friendly & pro-active and made it feel like a true vacation. Will be back again next year!
Great service, awesome food, best location and always friendly people. The pool is stylish and has a great vibe and view! We will be back!

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites Miami Wynwood Design District
review_text: Alberte was amazing and super nice! She went out of her way to make our stay comfortable and incredibly patient! Convenient location

We had a blast! We enjoyed traveling to and from the Walt Disney theme parks via shuttles daily! The beds were clean and comfortable. We had modern clean room, with entertainment equipment options throughout. Great restaurants with a variety of food options. Great view and willing to enjoy again!

My wife and I had a wonderful stay here for two weeks from 12th November to 26th November to celebrate my 70th birthday. The hotel and room was lovely (we had a room overlooking Volcano Bay). We found all of the staff to be polite and helpful and a real credit to the hotel, unlike lots of hotels. But some were outstanding. Our amazing stay began with Brenda on check in who was very cheerful and welcoming and really did set the tone for the rest of the holiday. In the Urban Pantry Jennifer and Ines were incredible, especially when they found out it was my birthday! They were always very friendly and upbeat and certainly made my special stay even more special. I must also give a huge shout out to Raven who when we returned after a tiring day was ready to serve us with ice cream and cookies at the Pizza station to help revive us. (A big thank you from Chris "The Cookie Queen".) In the shop Hannah and Patrick were super helpful. I must also make a special mention to our Housekeeper for whom nothing was too much trouble and going out of her way to ensure our room was made up, even late into the afternoon.(I'm sorry that I didn't get your name) The position of the hotel is great even with no car. 5 minutes from Volcano Bay, 5 minutes from Sapphire Falls and the water transport and walking distance to CityWalk. We would definitely recommend this hotel and certainly stay here again!

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites Miami Wynwood Design District
review_text: Highly recommended! I must especially highlight the incredible help I received from Quinto, who went above and beyond to help me recover something very valuable that I had lost. He was proactive, kind, empathetic, and his attitude truly made all the difference. I’m also very grateful to the maintenance team for their support. The hotel itself is very comfortable, clean, and very well located. Overall, a wonderful experience. It’s truly a pleasure to find people like this. Quinto, thank you so much!!

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites Miami Wynwood Design District
review_text: Abdu was very helpful and courteous checking us in and making us feel welcome and the hotel as we arrived. Thank you I will come again.

If you like to pay to hear neighbors and people in the hallways go there urgently. To smell the odors of sewers that escape from showers according to the weather. Claim a turn down wholesale; quality of a motel but not at the price of a five star.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites Miami Wynwood Design District
review_text: The friendliness and helpfulness of Abdul from the front office is the first thing to highlight here. Just great!! The hotel itself is a bit old, but still very good. The location also top 👍

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites Miami Wynwood Design District
review_text: We had a great overnight experience, and the customer service was excellent. Alberte was very helpful and friendly, and answered all our questions. Would come back if I visit again.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites Miami Wynwood Design District
review_text: Excellent service from the front desk/ especially Alberte was xtra friendly I got upgraded to a corner suite without even asking for it

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites Miami Wynwood Design District
review_text: Today I booked with Mr . Quinto he helped me find a room that was perfect for me in terms of pricing showed me places to eat and help me become a member as well this is a member that everyone should have helping run they business I will definitely book with the hotel again great customer service from Quinto go check them out

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites Miami Wynwood Design District
review_text: Alberte at the registration desk was very pleasant, professional, and helpful!!!! She was an absolute deal to deal with!!

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites Miami Wynwood Design District
review_text: Our stay was excellent! On arrival, we were greeted by the awesome Quinto, who kindly set up our keys, provided us with information about local eateries, and was wonderful to speak with. It’s one of the best hotel stays we’ve had in years and made our first time in Miami even better. And a great view! We’ll be back. Highly recommend!

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites Miami Wynwood Design District
review_text: Ouinot was the best Great experience good service made sure made sure we had everything we need Great guy made sure we had everything excellent service everything we need was there

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites Miami Wynwood Design District
review_text: I had a great time checking in with Abdul. He helped my family with a discrepancy that was easily helped! This was an easy and great experience.
Overpriced. Very nice staff but poor management. Noisy room with neighborhood music at 1 am. Broken in room equipment.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites Miami Wynwood Design District
review_text: Great team! Very welcoming, amazing Hospitality. Great customer service from Albete & Travis! Need to make sure all outlets work in the rooms.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites Miami Wynwood Design District
review_text: We had a great time at this hotel, Quinto was an amazing manager , he did everything posible to make us feel welcome and comfortable, he is a great asset for your property. And this make our trip much better, he even followed up calling the room to make sure we were ok , amazing Thanks !!!! We will be back shortly

Very beautiful hotel in a central location. Came to Miami to celebrate a birthday and could not have asked for a better place to stay. After comparing AirBnB options we decided to stay at Hyde Midtown instead since for the same price as the AirBnB options the hotel offered a higher quality room. The location was our favorite part since we were able to visit every part of Miami with a quick couple minutes drive. There is also everything you can need walking distance with all the surrounding stores and nightlife. Staff was very friendly and helpful the entire weekend. The room itself was clean, spacious, and offered a nice view of the open park outside. There was also a very large gym within the hotel that was bigger than most we've seen at other hotels with good array of equipment along with a nice rooftop pool. Overall, we will definitely be coming back any time we visit Miami.

Not recommended. Location is the only good thing about this hotel. You will be disappointed as I was. The building feels older. In the hallways there was permeating odor of socks or wet bathing suit. The entire hotel smelled musty. The room decor and furnishings were cheap and more in line with a discount motel then an upscale, premium product. The towels are threadbare and cheap. We stayed on a Sunday night and there are no dining options within walking distance so we ate at the hotel "restaurant" which is more like a cafeteria. The food was awful and one of the employees insisted I bus my own table and sort the dishes, silverware, and trash for her. When I declined, she called me an "entitled a**." Well, yes ma'am, I did just spend $78 for slop, I might be entitled to something. I would never stay here again and I will warn everyone visiting Universal to not stay here.

We visited for a quick 10th Anniversary getaway, and were greeted warmly with congratulations during arrival. We were assigned a beautiful room with many thoughtful amenities within that made it feel like home. This hotel has great style and meticulous cleaning standards. All staff were eager to help when asked but discreet when assistance was not required. We would gladly stay again in the future.
They don’t clean the rooms during visit, which is unacceptable at these room rates. They ran out of shampoo and didn’t have any at the front desk. Motel 6 has better service and cleanliness.

The hotel is beautiful and the front desk staff are a pleasure to deal with. The room is amazing and clean. The hotel restaurant has delicious food as well and complimentary breakfast every morning! The only bad part is paying $600 for the room and not being able to use the additional benefits through AMEX hotel collection. Would not offer a room upgrade after asking every day of the stay. Got strung along with the response of "check back tomorrow we show availability"

We had to choose a location that wasn't too distant from Miami International Airport, and Midtown Miami proved to be very convenient. The Hyde is super well located. It is comfortable and the staff is very friendly. It has many shops around and is a few blocks from the design district and Wynwood!

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites Miami Wynwood Design District
review_text: The hotel is nice, rooms in good condition and clean with good linen! The attention of Quinto deserves 5 stars, as it helped me in the cancellation of my stay and explains everything. However the dismal reception I had on 31.12.25 and the service on 1.1.26 makes me rate the hotel poorly. Miss. Alberte was uncollaborative in receiving me, as I did not speak English nor did she only do Spanish with her head that she did not and looked ahead, there was no possibility of communicating with her, let alone using a translator, obviously nothing could consuntar, the only thing the wifi, no excursions, no taxi reservations, or tips of some events that I had seen to go to the night of the end of the year. He would tell the hotel owner that a poorly served guest will not return and advises anyone not to go to his hotel, perhaps before spending so many dollars on advertising, employees should be taught that their job is to house people and that if they do not speak their language as anywhere in the world a translator can be used to help without mistreating.
David was amazing. Kind, efficient, professional. Everything! We arrived early, had all sorts of naive questions. He was patient and everything worked out. Fantastic!

I really loved this hotel. Stayed here with my mother for 2 nights in November. Room was great with a lovely view over the bay from the balcony. Bed was large and comfortable. The breakfast was delicious with a picturesque setting on the roof terrace, and the roof-top pool was beautiful and a perfect temperature to swim in. We also had snacks at the bar on the ground floor which were delicious (so much so we had them every day). The staff were also all very friendly. I'll definitely come back. We also loved the beautiful interior design shop which is attached to the hotel.

I love this property! It is in a perfect location. The staff are amazing! Special thank you to Jean Baptiste from valet, he is always so friendly and courteous and always remembers to put my seat back to it's original place!

I very rarely write reviews, but our stay at the Mayfair was flawless. It is such a beautiful building and our room was absolutely gorgeous. As mentioned in other places, people like Fernando made it a truly special experience. The room was quiet, the bed was comfortable and the balcony was so cozy and private. Cannot wait to go back!

We had an excellent 9 night stay at this hotel. The employees are superb and highly trained. The front desk, the housekeeping and Joseph at the pool bar really made our stay very enjoyable. Joseph couldn’t be more helpful, he knew our names and drinks and how we liked to be set up. He was interested in where we came from and couldn’t have done any more to make us feel welcome and appreciated. We had a lovely room with a bay view. It was quiet and clean and spacious. The robes and towels were super white and fluffy. Housekeeping did a great job and the turndown service came with Venchi chocolates and plenty of water. The roof top pool was busy over New Year but we had 2 beds and great service. The pool was heated which is appreciated at this time of the year. We loved the location as Coconut Grove had lots of restaurants and shops. We ate at the pool bar and Bellinis and they were good but expensive. WiFi was strong and I really couldn’t fault the hotel.
