I used the gym every other day and mostly had it to myself. The gym was small but well equipped and had water and towels. Whoever recruits and trains the people who work in the hotel is to be commended as they were efficient and polite and helpful and unlike most of Miami they didn’t constantly look for gratuities. They wanted to do a great job which is a refreshing change. Obviously we did tip but we didn’t feel pressurised like other hotels. There was no upselling either. We will most certainly return. Thank you Mr C.

On a recent trip to Miami, I decided to check out as many properties as possible and enjoyed a night in the Wynwood area of the city. The AC Miami Wynwood hotel is situated close to local bars and restaurants, together with plenty of shopping opportunities. The hotel is also particularly generous when it comes to Titanium/Platinum benefits. Although a $30 resort fee is added to the bill, $15 of this can be used towards food and beverages. I was staying with my two children and was given $10 credit per person meaning breakfast was essentially paid for. Breakfast was a buffet or a la carte. Children were charged half price. It meant that for my $45 bill the entirety was covered by the $30 Titanium breakfast credit and the $15 resort fee rebate. The rooms are cozy and modern. I love the hardwood floor that runs throughout all of the AC hotels I’ve stayed at. The shower too was also particularly powerful. The hotel also has a great rooftop area with a warm rooftop pool. There are deck chairs and daybeds aligning the pool area and there also looked to be a restaurant and bar in operation at the time I was there. For those who love to watch the arrivals into Miami International Airport, you’re in luck! The planes coming in to land from the east fly directly over the hotel. There is also a super view of the Miami Skyline from the very same rooftop. Car parking at the hotel is on the pricey side with a charge of around $50 to park overnight. However, next door to the hotel is a private car park where you can leave your vehicle for 24 hours for just $20. I would encourage anyone looking to park close to the hotel to simply do that rather than pay the extortionate fee the hotel wished to charge me. There is also street parking directly in front of the hotel but this can only be for a maximum of five hours so it would not be any good for those who sleep more than that in a single night! It was interesting for me to stay in this part of Miami having never visited in the past and I would definitely return in the future should the opportunity arise.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites Miami Wynwood Design District
review_text: Very good hotel, located in an emerging area of Miami, with zero danger to walk at night. Good breakfast, paid parking in the same hotel, good service, finally highly recommended. Data: It is a 2 minute walk from a chesse and wine bar which is very entertaining.

Access to Universal Studios and Islands of Adventure: You can walk to Universal Studios or Islands of Adventure from this hotel - probably about 15 - 20 minutes along the garden path. You can take the water taxi available behind the Sapphire Falls hotel across the street. There is also a shuttle to all three parks including Epic Universe. Volcano Bay is located very close to the hotel. Epic Universe: You can not walk to this park. There is a regular shuttle from the hotel that runs consistently. It is a 15-20 minute bus ride to this park. Access to amenities at other Universal Hotels: You can request an amenity key at the other Lowe's properties including Sapphire Falls across the way. This gives you access to the pools at all the Universal hotel properties. Hotel accommodations: There is everything you need, but it is very basic and grey. The water pressure in the shower is great and while you can hear the roads behind you, inside the hotel is pretty quiet. The pillows are not good, however. We got two adjoining rooms - and there is a small fridge, but for families looking to spread out and prepare food - this is not the appropriate choice. Food at the hotel: There is a nice rooftop bar area with snacks and great views. In the lobby there is a Starbucks, pizza area, and cafeteria type place with family friendly food. It isn't terribly pricey.

I wanted to wait a week since returning from my trip to this hotel in order to render a fair assessment, not one based on immediate feelings. To be fair, this place merits a very average rating, by no means terrible, but a place in need of fixing. Let me elaborate. To start with, the front desk. There isn’t any! It’s just a circular table manned by one or two workers, though it could be mistaken for a work area for the guests. There is nothing inviting about it. Very odd. So now we move onto the room itself in which there is a very dangerous situation: the shower. It is not a walk-in shower, but rather an old fashioned bathtub. And an extremely high one at that. It was not easy to get in by any stretch. Once in, it was quite slippery with nary a grab bar in site. I’m in my early 60s, in excellent health and I really don’t see how an elderly person can use it. Finally, there is no door to the shower. The water was flying everywhere and piling up on the floor! Once again, very, very, odd. The rest of the room was situated nicely, but it was way too dark. It was really difficult to read anything without going right up to the light. We had to use our flashlights on our cells to see items in our bags. Beyond odd. There were good points: The hotel itself is picturesque with greenery everywhere. (Though since it is open air, it gets cool at times.) The pool was nicely heated, the staff attentive. The balcony or outdoor area was the highlight. The hotel itself is centrally located. But in end, I cannot get past the above-mentioned issues and thus cannot recommend this place.

We chose this hotel for an overnight birthday celebration in Miami, bringing our dog along. While the Coconut Grove location proved ideal and the staff consistently demonstrated friendliness and professionalism, the room itself fell short of expectations—particularly given the nearly $1,000 cost (including pet fee) for a single night. Room 410 felt surprisingly basic: compact layout with beds, TV, desk, and bathroom, but lacking standard amenities we’ve come to expect at this price tier. Notably absent were a coffee maker and traditional iron/ironing board (only a steamer provided). The bathroom, while clean and functional, featured only a shower. There was also loud music that kept us awake for a large part of the night from a nearby venue. Having stayed at numerous Fine Hotels & Resorts properties previously, we’ve experienced exceptional quality that justifies premium pricing. Unfortunately, this property didn’t meet that standard. I’d compare it to a solid four-star European hotel or approximately 3.5-star American equivalent—perfectly adequate, but not luxury-level. Recommendation: Request detailed room information and photos before booking to ensure it meets your expectations for the price point. When told if the experience, the front desk clerk gave me a card and assured me that the room would be much better and quieter should we visit again. Polite, but not particularly helpful since we do not plan on returning.

LOVED this hotel. Rooms were so clean and comfy they had all the amenities you needed, coffee machine, iron, hair dryer etc. clean was freshened up everyday. The tablet was a cool touch too. The most amazing part was the view we had of islands of adventure. I could see all the rides it was amazing, as well as the firework drone show at night we were able to see that from our room too. The pool area was great nice pool and hot tub and backs onto the volcano bay water park!! There was a restaurant area and the food was delicious, a handy Starbucks too. The gym had everything you needed for a quick holiday workout. The staff were all so friendly I loved every minute of this stay. We were also a less than 15 min walk to the park, it was a beautiful garden walk. There is also regular free shuttle buses and a free water taxi which was really cute. Definitely recommend this hotel !!

We had a Kids Suite with Adjoining 2 Queen Bed Room (booked as one unit) and it was plenty of space for our 7 night stay. The room and hotel was clean and well maintained, with very helpful and friendly staff, and a great location. Between the shuttle, the water taxi available across the street, or the walking path, we could get to CityWalk, IoA, or Universal Studios in about 15 minutes. Would definitely stay again. I did take the advice of other reviewers and have a noise machine to help block out street noise while sleeping. We slept great!
We stayed almost a whole week and loved the Mayfair as our base to explore Miami!
Great service, location and room. Bellini restaurant is also very good. A relaxing break in superb surroundings, the room was well furnished and large, bed very comfortable. Highly recommend

No doubt, the location is great if you want to be in the heart of Coconut Grove. However, be prepared for dark, dated rooms with no view. It was so dim in the room, it made me think it wasn’t clean. Our room was not cleaned the next day, even when we were asked what time we wanted the room to be cleaned. The music from the wedding downstairs kept us up. I understand that there are lots of weddings at this location and they are allowed to play music until 11:00 pm. Many of our invoices were incorrect and we are still trying to sort it out. Fernando (at check-in) was very nice but ultimately had to “punt” issues up to management to follow up on.

We landed in Miami because we could not get back to the West Coast due to the many airline cancellations. The greeters were very nice and helpful. They also made some great restaurant recommendations. The neighborhood is wonderful, family-friendly, and feels very safe. The hotel's vibe and architecture are iconic — really a work of art. The rooftop pool and bar offered a serene, yet fun, escape. Really, a wonderful experience, and I was happy to get to see this slice of Miami life. I would love to come back. The only negative was that we asked for a late checkout and were denied. Its' OK to be denied because of staffing arrangements. However, we were told that the hotel was "fully booked". It was not even close to being booked and/or busy on a Tuesday. Management, please don't tell your employees to lie, have them say "unfortunately we cannot accommodate your request, but we have these options...." Lying has become too commonplace these days; let's all do better. (As a side, we met people at the pool, who just didn't ask and brought their suitcases up to the pool, stayed the afternoon, and changed in the changing rooms. And no, they did not ask permission.)

This being my first solo trip, I wanted to ensure I stayed at a safe, comfortable hotel, and I landed on Aventura. This proved to be a great decision, and as my 7-night stay here has sadly ended, I am very happy with the quality and overall comfort levels this hotel provided! Firstly, it is quite small, and doesn’t require a ton of walking to get anywhere you need to. I LOVED this aspect. Checking in was a breeze, and I was pleasantly surprised to be upgraded to a skyline view on the 16th floor, a wonderful start to the trip! Shout out to Tina at the front desk! From my room, I had a gourgeous full view of Islands of Adventure and the beautiful resort next door, as well as sweeping views of the rest of Orlando. I have seen in other people’s comments about the 16th floor that noise from the rooftop bar being directly above was an issue, and I am pleased to say that it was it was NOT an issue for me. Perhaps it was where my room was situated in the building, but I wasn’t affected at all by noise overhead, nor from other rooms. Initially, my minifridge wasn’t working properly. A quick text to the front desk to alert them of this, and within 30 minutes a team member arrived and promptly replaced the fridge. He also helped me set up streaming on the TV and answered any other questions I had. The location of this hotel is conveniently located close to the parks, so a brisk walk, bus or water taxi ride away. The pool area is very relaxing and nicely setup. The rooftop bar is nice, though I’m not a social or drinking person so I didn’t spend a lot of time up there. Urban Pantry has a lot of options for food, and being vegetarian, this was much appreciated. Overall, this hotel was be a great place to chill and hang out as a break from busy park days. I will definitely be returning here on my next holiday. The skyline view is a must!!

We used this hotel twice as we were on a Cunard cruise. We had rooms on the 6th floor both spacious well appointed, clean with a comfy bed and good Wi-Fi. Both rooms have small kitchens including a fridge but there is no cutlery or plates etc. There are two mugs for the coffee machine and glasses for water. There is sufficient storage space and a good safe. The bathrooms are large and security is good. You can't access the lift without your key card. Staff are very helpful, friendly and courteous. Our thanks to Jessa Robinson for upgrading us on our return visit and the female member of staff who assisted us with an Uber for the airport, much cheaper than a yellow cab. We also had late check outs and they have storage for your luggage in the lobby. The hotel is situated in the heart of midtown near a crossroads junction, road noise is noticeable. The hotel is also under the flight path of Miami airport and flights can be low. Fortunately flights are reduced in the evening and room insulation reduces exterior the noise. There are plenty of places within walking distance to eat both for breakfast and dinner. Our favourite for breakfast was Angelina's. There is also a good bakery round the corner from the hotel plus an Italian restaurant called Salumeria (advisable to book). We also tried a Mexican called Bakan and an Argentinian called Chimba. There is also a sports bar across from the hotel called Taps 42 with a good selection of drinks. Food is okay as well. The hotel is within walking distance of the Design district with lots of high end shops, cafe's and restaurants. It is also near the Wynwood area which has outdoors art, graffiti and also some good museums. If you get chance try and visit Cars & Guitars. Nice coffee bar, but the cars and guitars are the stars. There is also a hop on hop off bus stop near the hotel which will take you to the beach and Little Havana. So our thanks to Henry the general manager and the staff who made our time in Miami enjoyable. We would return should we visit Miami again.

A wonderful hotel with a very stylish interior, great service and a marvelous restaurant. The rooms are marsterfully designed to make you feel on a luxurious boat. A very friendly, cooperative and professional staff. Amazing experience!

It was the second time we stayed in this hotel, and again we had proper care. The main attraction of this hotel is its modernity, combined with the benefits of staying in a hotel with a Universal complex, such as transportation and early entry into the Universal parks.
Phenomenal stay. A great mix of luxury and home feeling. Staff, especially Fernando, personally went above and beyond.

Was recommended by a friend that had stayed there whose son lives nearby so they'd stayed there a lot. It's a classic 1960s motel, complete with retro signage. Rooms and property all updated and modern.

The Vagabond is my secret go-to spot with 5-minute access to the beaches, fantastic, clean, renovated rooms, a quirky, retro vibe, and super friendly staff that treats me like family. The pool area is fantastic – well-maintained, great for cooling off after a beach day, and has that vintage Florida motel charm that’s impossible not to love. If you’re looking for authentic Miami vibes, great value, and a place that feels like a home away from home, book the Vagabond. Just… maybe don’t tell too many people. 😉​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​

I've stayed at Vagabond Hotel multiple times, and it remains one of my favorite places in Miami. Recently stayed again and had another great experience. The room was clean, comfortable, and well designed. The location is very convenient, and the staff is consistently friendly, helpful, and welcoming. The grounds are beautiful, and the retro, mid-century vibe gives the hotel so much character and charm. It’s a relaxing, stylish place that always feels special. We’ve had nothing but positive experiences here and would absolutely stay again. Highly recommended.
5+ The service is excellent. Nikole is a fabulous yoga teacher. Breakfast has been perfect. Gym has everything needed. Spectacular little oasis.

The staff were wonderful, and the architecture is world-class. Unfortunately, the suite we were in felt very neglected. The windows needed serious cleaning, and the upholstery was faded, torn, and/or stained. It was also fairly noisy at night, due to loud partying in the neighborhood on the weekend nights, and general traffic noise other times. With some TLC, this could be a world-class hotel, but it definitely wasn't worth the price, and did not feel like a luxury hotel like it probably used to be.

We recently stayed at Universal’s / Loews’ Aventura hotel and I felt compelled to write this review to warn other travellers of our experience. Firstly, the hotel room was dirty when we arrived. The bathroom still had dust, hair and dirt in the corners and the floors were not clean. However, we chose not to mention this to the staff as we had been told our room would be cleaned every other day, so figured it would soon be resolved and put it down to an oversight on the part of a likely overworked housekeeping team. On the day we were told the room would be serviced for the first time, it was not done. This was despite us being out almost the whole day at the parks, leaving the housekeeping team plenty of time to do it. We had to chase the front desk several times to ask for housekeeping, who did not come. Instead we were left a bag of towels, and new sheets for us to make our beds ourselves late at night when we returned from the parks. Again, we complained and asked that housekeeping come the following day instead to clean the room. This time they made one of the two beds, emptied the bins and replenished the coffee but still did not clean the floors, bathroom etc. When we complained yet again, we were told that it was already ‘a lot’ that housekeeping had made one of the beds as normally they only empty the bins and that’s it! So this was supposedly going above and beyond their normal service. Frankly that is not good enough for the room rates charged by the hotel. While we were offered a small room credit in compensation for the housekeeping problems, this was not a true resolution of the issue. It took until the fifth day of our stay for the room to be cleaned to a somewhat acceptable standard, and this only after a lot of chasing and complaints. As well as this, the hotel charged us 3 separate times for the same set of drinks, and twice for the same meal. When questioned why this had happened, they accused us of adding additional items to the bill after we signed the cheque for the meal to charge it to the room (we did not) and blamed ‘occasional issues with international cards’ for the triple drinks charges. When we queried why we had been charged over $200 for a meal and some drinks that came to a total of around $70, we were told repeatedly that everything was fine from their end and that all the charges were correct. This was despite us having a photograph of the cheque which clearly stated the amount authorised to be charged to the room, as well as evidence of the multiple charges debited from our account. As unauthorised charges kept getting made to my card I eventually had to contact my bank to put a block on the card before the hotel took all the available spending money I had in my account. All of this wasted hours of my day and wiped out a full day we could have enjoyed in the parks due to the stress and anxiety caused. During discussions with the manager I was repeatedly spoken to in a condescending tone and told that they ‘couldn’t explain it any simpler’ for me to understand. I was made to feel stupid for even questioning the charges, and told over and over that everything they had done was correct. Both myself and my partner were made to feel like we were causing unnecessary problems by simply chasing money that had been wrongly taken from us and asking to receive the service we paid more than £1000 for - namely a clean, comfortable hotel room for our much anticipated holiday. This has left an incredibly sour taste in our mouth and ruined the final part of our trip. As well as this: - the hotel is incredibly noisy. Despite being on the 15th floor, we had constant traffic noise day and night from the highway and the noise of other people’s toilets flushing and random banging noises 24/7. - the tablet that controls the tv advertises the ability to use Netflix, Prime video and YouTube but these do not work and you must cast from your phone. - you must control all the lights in the room using the tablet, which is pointless Overall, the only positives going for the hotel have been its proximity to universal and the better hotel next door, the free shuttles to the parks, and the friendly (but often very slow) service from some (but certainly not all) of the staff. Although billed as a prime value hotel, Aventura is nothing of the sort. You will do better to save your money for fast passes and taxis to the parks, and stay off property somewhere with proper housekeeping and better standards. I’m sure that this review will receive the standard comment that the feedback will be passed on to the manager to ensure other guests do not have the same experience. However, judging by previous similar reviews from other guests dating back several years, there is zero intention to make any meaningful improvements to the hotel and this will continue to be the way Aventura operates. Avoid.
Very comfortable Hotel with nice roof Top Bar and Pool. Hotel staff was very friendly. Close to Shops and. Restaurant at Coconut Grove.

The hotel is in a good location and has nice aesthetics. I enjoyed using the hot tub, and while it was too cold to use the pool during my stay, the pool area was beautiful. However, I don't believe this is a luxury hotel or that it's worth the price tag. There was no furniture on our balcony and certain items were not well stocked in our room (there was a kitchenette, but only two glasses and no way to wash them; no cutlery; only one coffee pod for the machine). There is a restaurant on site, but when we checked in we were told "there is no restaurant here" (it was closed for a private event the night we arrived). We were also told that we could request an upgrade (based on my credit card status) if we had an issue with the room; we were close to the elevators, so I decided to ask...only to be told we couldn't move. I'm usually not so picky with hotels and I tend to travel fairly frugally, and I do think it's a nice hotel. However, from my experience, the price does not match the amenities or service.

I would highly recommend this hotel. I am basing this especially on the service of the staff especially Jesse, she went out of way to ensure our needs were met. The room was especially clean and had everything we needed. The location was amazing, right next to a Starbucks. Thanks for a great stay!
Rooms very dark: lighting was terrible. No fan in interior bathroom. Electric (fuse) blew twice due to old wiring. But breakfast was very good. Rooftop pool and bar very nice.
Great Boutique hotel. Built in the 50's and renovated very nice. Clean rooms, and hip. The pool area is like a tropical paradise. Office staff was great, check in and out was easy.

My husband and I stayed at the Aventura for 3 nights while visiting before a cruise. We checked in late (close to 11 pm) on a Wednesday evening, the lobby was mostly empty so we were checked in very quickly. We got to our room and immediately noticed the tablet wasn't properly connected to our reservation (it was displaying that the room wasn't rented) which prevented us from fully accessing everything. We called the front desk and they sent someone up, he was there for a solid 10-15 minutes but couldn't figure out what the issue was. Eventually it seemed to self-correct, though, so I guess it ended up being a non-issue? Overall though this was a perfect example of "just because you can, doesn't mean you should." The tech-enabled features of the room were really more of a hindrance than a help, as it caused issues with turning on lights (if you turn any light on or off manually by accident, it would stop working on the tablet), some of the light switches on the tablet didn't work at all, and the TV controls were finicky (and of course, the actual remote that was in our room didn't work either). It just seemed like if you're going to commit to that level of technology in every room, you need to make sure it REALLY works and is reliable. It's just not there yet. All that said, the room was extremely clean, the view from our room was beautiful, the bed was very comfortable, there was plenty of storage, the proximity to the parks was perfect, the staff was friendly, and having a Starbucks in the lobby was very convenient for quick coffees and grab-and-go breakfasts before taking the shuttle to the parks. For these reasons, we would stay at the hotel again and because we'd anticipate technology issues, it wouldn't be as much of a headache.
Oscar at the front desk was very helpful when we had questions. He was able to answer them all and accommodate us very nicely. Hotel environment and staff were phenomenal! Highly recommended!

The rooms are extremely noisy as the s are paper thin. Also, the security and staff smell of marijuana when they deliver things to your room. Not exactly 4 or 5 star quality. There are 3 managers, all of which are rude and arrogant. Terrible service. I will stay at a real 5 star hotel next time. Try the Mayfair hotel where they have actually good service, or four seasons.

This hidden gem is located in a great spot within walking distance to quite a few restaurants. The motel will surprise you with its special touches. Like robes, which you would not expect from a motel. Lovely staff, well maintained rooms and it is extremely clean. The pool area is serene with nice lounges and beautiful well maintained landscaping. Great place!

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites Miami Wynwood Design District
review_text: Location was very convenient for what we wanted to do. The room did not have view or nice scenery, we were facing a parking garage with neon lights on all night long. The room is outdated and could be much more cleaner. Bed sheets were stained, we even had a pillow stained with old blood, towels were stained, shower curtain had a really bad smell, like wet dog smell and floors were covered in dust. I had to use a bedsheet on the floor as a rug for my kid and I to be able to walk in socks before getting to bed. The lobby had a good welcoming aroma but the seats were also super stained, I preferred staying standing up rather than sitting every time we went downstairs. Honestly the place did not meet my expectations, at least employees were cordial. I would definitely not repeat or recommend this hotel.

I had such a great experience at Mr. C Miami – Coconut Grove. From the second I walked in, everything just felt right. The staff greeted me with genuine warmth (not that forced hotel friendliness), and the welcome drink was such a nice touch after traveling. The room was super clean, beautifully styled, and honestly just felt peaceful. You can tell they care about the details — everything was polished but still comfortable. Anytime we needed something, the front desk was quick, helpful, and easy to deal with. It’s rare to stay somewhere that feels both upscale and relaxed at the same time, but Mr. C nailed it. If you’re heading to Miami and want somewhere that delivers across the board, this is it. I’ll definitely be back.

My husband and I recently came back from the Vagabond and are already planning our trip back! This hotels vintage Miami vibe is everything!! Billie is amazing, and so knowledgeable! The beds were super comfy, and the rooms clean and bright!

hotel_name: Brickell Arch, A Luxury Collection Hotel, Miami
review_text: We had a day pass at the hotel and came with a pretty big group, so there was a lot of baggage and moving parts to manage. Eli and Mario were great from the start. They helped us with our luggage, kept everything organized, and made the whole arrival feel smooth even with the size of our group. They stayed professional, friendly, and efficient the entire time. It made a big difference having that kind of support, especially with so many people and bags. Really appreciate Eli and Mario for making it easy. 10/10 Will be back again !

Cute clean rooms, great service, Beautiful pool area (with lively but chill music), fun neighborhood (but inconveniently located for hot spots). Pool bar was closed which was disappointing. If pool bar was open would five 5 stars. Hope it and restaurant bounce back because otherwise it’s a fabulous place!

hotel_name: Brickell Arch, A Luxury Collection Hotel, Miami
review_text: Eli and Eduardo were really helpful and very kind!

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites Miami Wynwood Design District
review_text: Great front desk service, really really friendly staff. Thank you!

Really nice motel Clean rooms perfectly equipped with bathrobe , spacious shower , very comfortable bedding Very friendly welcome The place is magical with a relaxing pool: chill music and really nice retro decor A little piece of paradise in the middle of Miami We highly recommend this small hotel for a break of one night or more All the staff is really charming Free parking on site

hotel_name: Brickell Arch, A Luxury Collection Hotel, Miami
review_text: Elijah Eduardo at AKA Brickell was amazing! Super professional, quick, and genuinely kind. He made the whole valet experience smooth and effortless. True 5-star service 👏

hotel_name: Brickell Arch, A Luxury Collection Hotel, Miami
review_text: Concert eve service was great. Handles our bags and very professional Arturo, Ellie, and Eduardo are great

hotel_name: Brickell Arch, A Luxury Collection Hotel, Miami
review_text: I would like to leave this review especially for the valet parking team at AKA Hotel in Brickell. I park my car here every day, and I can confidently say that the service is always excellent. Eduardo, Arturo, and Eli, and also Mario and Eduardo, are incredibly professional, attentive, and respectful. They always have a positive attitude, are quick, and consistent in their work. No matter the time of day, they maintain the same level of energy and kindness. They truly make my daily experience much more convenient and pleasant. I would also like to recognize the rest of the valet team in general. Everyone is organized, hardworking, and very friendly. You can clearly see the commitment and dedication they have to their job and to the people who come in every day.

hotel_name: Brickell Arch, A Luxury Collection Hotel, Miami
review_text: Excellent service all around. Outstanding valet service from Cesar, Paul and Rodrigo. Food at Adrift Mare is exceptional.

hotel_name: Brickell Arch, A Luxury Collection Hotel, Miami
review_text: Listen… when I say the morning valet team (Alexis Ellie Edward Mario Arturo Diego)needs a raise, I am dead serious. The AKA Hotel in Brickell is already nice, but the customer service hits you immediately when you get there no long awkward waits, just great service and good hospitality You can tell they take pride in what they do. It is welcoming without being fake, professional without being stiff. That first impression sets the whole tone, and they do not miss. Give that morning team their flowers for real.

hotel_name: Brickell Arch, A Luxury Collection Hotel, Miami
review_text: I forgot his name, but he was working valet and I even have a picture with him because he was that funny. 😄 He had such a charming energy while still handling everything professionally. He kept things moving, took care of my car, and somehow still had time to joke around and make the experience feel personal. It did not feel strict and overly formal, just genuine and welcoming. He definitely adds personality to the team. Great service and great greeter!

The Vagabond Hotel was amazing! The room my friend and I shared was spacious and clean. The staff were incredibly welcoming and friendly. Although there is no restaurant on premise, we received an extensive list of restaurants within walking distance from the hotel. The Vagabond is situated in the MiMo section of Miami - which is the perfect place to retreat from the hustle and bustle of the downtown area. I highly recommend the Vagabond; it was fantastic.
Fernando , Dakota , Simon and ariana made all the difference . Best service we’ve ever had .

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites Miami Wynwood Design District
review_text: Went for a girls trip and this was an excellent hotel with attentive and friendly staff! Definitely recommend

hotel_name: Brickell Arch, A Luxury Collection Hotel, Miami
review_text: I was in town for work and there was a lot of construction going on nearby. The noise was definitely noticeable, especially after long days of meetings. Not the most relaxing background sound. That said, the valet team really made up for it. Elia and Mario were great. super professional without being stiff. They moved quickly, handled everything smoothly, and just made the whole process easy. Even with the construction happening, their service stood out and honestly made the experience better. Appreciate them for that.

hotel_name: Brickell Arch, A Luxury Collection Hotel, Miami
review_text: honestly just trying to get in and out without any stress. Arturo, Ella, and Eduardo made that super easy. They greeted me right away with a great attitude and just good energy overall. It was a simple interaction, but the way they carried themselves made it stand out. Really appreciate the team effort and positive

hotel_name: Brickell Arch, A Luxury Collection Hotel, Miami
review_text: Great valet, great hotel stay!

hotel_name: Brickell Arch, A Luxury Collection Hotel, Miami
review_text: I’ll be honest, my first impression of the area was not great. I was in town for a work trip, and between the loud construction next door and how expensive everything in Brickell is, I was already a little annoyed. Brickell just isn’t really my vibe. But I have to say, the valet experience completely shifted my mood. Elia and Mario were genuinely excellent. From the moment I pulled up, they brought great energy. They were welcoming, professional, and even gave a few kind compliments that honestly made my day better. It did not feel forced. It felt natural and sincere. After dealing with a long work day and the noise around the area, that positive interaction mattered more than they probably realize. They handled my car quickly, stayed attentive, and kept a calm presence even with everything going on. The location might not be my favorite, but the service from Elia and Mario definitely stood out in the best way.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites Miami Wynwood Design District
review_text: The only positive about this hotel was the friendly staff at check-in. Unfortunately, everything else was a major disappointment. The air quality in our room was very poor, and both my wife and I experienced allergy attacks during our stay. The worst part, however, was the nonstop partying and screaming in the hallways on multiple floors until about 4:30 a.m. Despite repeated calls to the front desk, most of which went unanswered, nothing was done to address the situation. We got virtually no sleep. The rooms themselves are very basic and not on par with other Hampton Inns that I’ve stayed at in the past. Under no circumstances should this hotel be on your consideration list. I would not recommend staying here.

The hotel is surrounded in a diverse location. Lots of restaurants and cafe's in walking distance. The 50's and 60's vibe is very unique. The rooms are updated, clean and spacious. I loved the oversized shower and large bathroom counter space. The pool was my favorite place to read my book and visit with family. We had pool towels in the room and bathrobes at the ready. The free coffee in the lobby was the best hotel coffee I have ever had by far. They pride themselves on the coffee. It has is minor drawbacks, like carrying luggage up the stairs, but then this just adds to the ambiance. Couldn't have been more please and would stay again.

This beautiful hotel is perfectly located but service was uneven. From the hotel, it's an easy walk to scores of restaurants and shops, many directly across the street. As noted by others, valet is very quick and there are also several parking garages just a few steps away. While we noticed a number of weddings and celebrations during our stay, the hotel seemed to handle the traffic well and although one weekend evening had a band on the roof, we enjoyed it. The rooftop pool is small but lovely. The central garden is gorgeous and the second floor offers seating by the fountains. The rooms themselves are dark but we enjoyed the respite from the heat and from our 5th floor location, the balcony was sufficient when we wanted a bit more light. Breakfast and room service offerings are limited but adequate. In our five day stay, we found the service very uneven. We often made requests multiple times with different staff, particularly to get the room tidied and restocked and also in restaurants to get our full orders to the table. Everyone was very nice but seems a bit disorganized and for the price, we did expect a better experience. Common areas appeared spotless.

hotel_name: Brickell Arch, A Luxury Collection Hotel, Miami
review_text: Excellent hotel, Eduardo and Arthur's attention in the valet parking was very good.

hotel_name: Brickell Arch, A Luxury Collection Hotel, Miami
review_text: Stayed at AKA Brickell and I have to say, Eli and Eduardo from the bag /valet service were amazing. They were polite, quick, They really made the arrival feel smootoooth I’ll be honest, the hotel itself has a few things it could improve on, but the valet team definitely carries the experience. The service from Eli and Eduardo stood out Great energy, professional, and on point.

hotel_name: Brickell Arch, A Luxury Collection Hotel, Miami
review_text: Good afternoon, I stayed at that hotel a month ago. The service was excellent, and the staff were knowledgeable about everything I might need, especially regarding the welcome, help with luggage, and recommending places to go. Above all, they were very friendly and welcoming. Thank you so much, Mario (valet parking team).

The Vagabond's location was perfect and free parking was an added bonus. We loved the retro feel and hotel was very clean. Our room was spacious and very well appointed and it was very comfortable and the shower felt like a spa. We also enjoyed the pool area and swimming was delightful and just the right temperature with easy access from our room. It was very quiet and we would definitely stay here again. Staff was very accommodating. The restaurant was closed for renovations and the staff offered other great places to eat that were within walking distance.

Truly a great gem of a hotel in Miami. Reasonable rate for the room which was spacious and clean. The day beds around the pool were perfect for relaxing. I could have stayed here all week! The hotel was also able to accommodate our early arrival (9am). While we did have to pay half of the rate for the day, it was worth it after getting up incredibly early to travel. Lots of great restaurants within walking distance and the staff were super friendly. Highly recommend and we will definitely return.

hotel_name: Brickell Arch, A Luxury Collection Hotel, Miami
review_text: Elijah was very helpful and going above and beyond his duties

This hotel should be protected as an historic architectural gem. Loved the 80s design and detail. Service was great, rooms charming and clean. Ideal location. Pool nice. Loved the claw footed tub in the room. Everyday Yoga excellent and made the stay worth it! Coffee each morning much appreciated. It’s the small amenities that make a huge difference.

hotel_name: Brickell Arch, A Luxury Collection Hotel, Miami
review_text: Thank you so much Elis and Mario, for your kindness and your help since we arrived at the hotel. We definitely will come back!!

hotel_name: Brickell Arch, A Luxury Collection Hotel, Miami
review_text: I’d like to take a moment to sincerely thank Elijah and Mario for such a wonderful experience. They are consistently quick, efficient, and truly brighten the day with their positive energy. I’m so grateful for everything you both do — thank you from the bottom of my heart!

hotel_name: Brickell Arch, A Luxury Collection Hotel, Miami
review_text: I would like to express my appreciation and gratitude to the exceptional service provided by the valet team. Both Mario and Elia were really helpful taking care of me and my friends. Thank you!
I was here for a business trip. Aisha was phenomenal! Her hospitality and charisma made me feel comfortable during my stay. She also has a genuine smile when you enter the hotel.

hotel_name: Brickell Arch, A Luxury Collection Hotel, Miami

The hotel has strange elevator system. It looks good from outside. Unfortunately I am still here. What a nightmare

hotel_name: Brickell Arch, A Luxury Collection Hotel, Miami
review_text: My family and I did a day pass at AKA before heading to our cruise, and the experience was great from start to finish. Elijah, Mario, Diego, and Alexis were exceptional. They were a huge help managing all of our bags. Even though they’re valet, they went above and beyond assisting us with luggage and making sure everything was organized and stress free. If you’re considering a day pass at AKA, I definitely recommend it. Great service like this really makes a difference.

Very nice place with a lot of character. Rooms are modern, clean, original and the pool is definitely a highlight of this historic place. Very friendly staff. Just regret that the restaurant was under renovation, but the bakery / café next door is very good. I highly recommend the Vagabond Hotel.

hotel_name: Brickell Arch, A Luxury Collection Hotel, Miami
review_text: Oscar gave us an excellent attetion Thanks for everything Was an amazing experience

hotel_name: Brickell Arch, A Luxury Collection Hotel, Miami
review_text: Mario, Alexis, Diego and their Valet crew are always accommodating to myself and family. Very friendly and warm welcoming 🙏🏾

hotel_name: Brickell Arch, A Luxury Collection Hotel, Miami
review_text: Amazing location. The space was very clean, and the service was excellent- Oscar ensured we had a great stay and was super welcoming and attentive! I will be booking again!

hotel_name: Brickell Arch, A Luxury Collection Hotel, Miami
review_text: Excellent hotel , super good Corami attention

hotel_name: Brickell Arch, A Luxury Collection Hotel, Miami
review_text: Excellent service from Corami and Oscar very friendly! I had a great time at the hotel I would definitely come back

hotel_name: Brickell Arch, A Luxury Collection Hotel, Miami
review_text: Excellent service at Corami y Dulce! The staff was friendly, attentive, and made the whole experience truly enjoyable. Highly recommended!

The hotel was very nice and clean, with tasty breakfast and friendly staff. We’ve had an issue with a delayed check in due to room not being ready at 3pm and the TV not working in our room - however staff was very apologetic and offered free parking and breakfast. In my opinion, the hotel only gets 4 starts as it’s expensive and you get an additional „destination fee” added on arrival of $30, giving you a credit of $15 to use in the hotel and other benefits such as 3h bike rental. Benefits that you are unlikely to use. Also, parking charge is $35 per day, with $7.70 self parking tax fee.

Beautiful looking hotel but when we checked in our room wasnt ready we were told we would be either messaged or called but no one contacted us at all.Room was lovely but the bed wasnt made properly the sheets were not tucked in at all. No Iron or board i had to ask for one and that did arrive the next morning. Valet parking did seem quick but it just felt like everyone was just after a huge tip !! Breakfast we waited 15 mins for a table once seated i asked could i just have 2 toast which was on the sides menu at a cost of $6 i was told it wasnt on the main menu so would be charged for it ,even though I didnt want the main costing $22 it just didnt make sense .Pool area was lovely but cocktails are very expensive .Overall nice hotel but I wouldnt go back .We did meet a lovely staff member called Michael but only once .Room cleaners came back on the 2nd day to clean but at 330pm we were resting before we went out for the evening .so told them no .I found it very frustrating staying at this hotel not relaxing at all !! We had previously tried to contact the hotel as this was a special trip for our 40th wedding anniversary they failed to contact us at all .Grwat shame !!

hotel_name: Brickell Arch, A Luxury Collection Hotel, Miami
review_text: i truly enjoyed my stay. The service was excellent, and Corami ensured everything went perfectly. I would definitely return.

hotel_name: Brickell Arch, A Luxury Collection Hotel, Miami
review_text: Beautiful hotel with an absolutely gorgeous view of the Biscayne Bay. My first impression was with the valet, Elijah, who welcomed me with a big, beautiful smile and was genuinely excited to meet me and assist with my bags!!! Then I ran into Paul, who I met 3 years ago when I visited the hotel. He remembered me and was able to point out several things that he remembered about my last stay and what car I used to drive. Then Oscar at the front desk was so friendly and accommodating. I wanted a large room on a high floor and Oscar walked me through the hotel, showed me a few rooms, and made sure I was happy with the size and the view of my room before leaving me (I had a lot of bags, and I love a great view)! Yes, my room was large. Yes, I had a great view! I also had a sofa, fridge, and they were able to bring in a microwave. And, every time I passed through the valet area I was personally greeted, and the door was held for me. The Adrift Mare restaurant, the rooftop pool and the outdoor sky lawn are all truly AMAZING!!! Elijah, Paul and Oscar and the entire staff provided awesome customer service and made my stay most enjoyable! I highly recommend this hotel and will stay there again on my next visit to Miami.

We stayed at this hotel for three weeks in February. It was our second longer term stay at the hotel, and we enjoyed it once again. The hotel rooms surround a beautiful courtyard filled with palm trees, plants and fountains. This space establishes the vibe for the hotel. The hotel is older with a lot of character and the rooms are comfortable. The construction of the building doesn't allow for a lot of natural light in the rooms, but we enjoyed the spacious balcony. The hotel is located steps away from the restaurants and commercial area of Coconut Grove. We also found it very easy to explore other Miami environs from this location including Little Havana, Wynwood, Coral Gables, Key Biscayne, South Beach and the Everglades. The breakfast included with the stay was very good and the staff attentive. Specifically, we'd like to recognize Emily, Lorenzo, Kaylan, and Marlene for their great service. We also got to know the valet staff well! Miguel, William, Carlos, Fabrizio, and Lazaro were all very professional and helpful. They were always very prompt in getting our car to us when we needed it and offered helpful advice. The only area of the hotel that needs some improvement is housekeeping. The staff was very friendly but sometimes we needed to make multiple requests to receive what we asked for.

Staff are extremely helpful and friendly. Offering a detailed explanation of all the best local spots for food and to explore. Rooms were spacious and the pool area was incredible but surprisingly quiet when we were there making for a very tranquil experience. Great value for money.

Had the pleasure of staying at Arlo Wynwood for one evening Friday February 20th prior to boarding our NCL cruise ship. All staff at check in were friendly upon arrival. The King size bed room was very clean and bed was comfortable. The rooftop pool is AMAZING. Food and drinks on the pool deck were delicious as well . Shout out to the female bartender there. she was very pleasant.:) a huge shout out to Shatoya in Security! I left my favorite hoodie in the lobby during check in. She helped me to co-ordinate a shipper to get it sent back to me in Canada :) We definitely will be staying in this hotel next February before we board next years cruise. I highly RECOMMEND Arlo Wynwood!!!!!

I had an amazing experience loved the hotel I want to give a special shout out to Nicholas at the valet, stand for all the extra help and hospitality, he is a very respectful and professional young man! 10/10 service

hotel_name: Brickell Arch, A Luxury Collection Hotel, Miami
review_text: From the moment I arrived, the experience was seamless. Corami made the check-in process smooth, efficient, and genuinely welcoming. After a long trip, that kind of energy makes all the difference. She was professional, attentive, and took the time to explain everything clearly without making it feel rushed. What truly stood out was how authentic the service felt. Oscar’s approach was natural and personable — not scripted, not forced. He was attentive without being intrusive and made the whole stay feel relaxed and comfortable. It’s rare to find that balance. Overall, the team created a first impression that set the tone for a great stay in Miami. I would definitely return.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites Miami Wynwood Design District
review_text: Great location, clean, quiet, wonderfully kind and helpful staff...thanks Eric (front desk)

We had the most amazing experience at Arlo Wynwood! I stayed here with my mom to celebrate her birthday, and everything exceeded our expectations. The hotel itself is beautiful. very modern, stylish, and clean. However what truly made our stay special, was the incredible staff. A huge shoutout to Savery and Iaisha at check-in who were so kind, warm, and genuinely helpful. They made my mom feel celebrated and made the entire arrival process smooth and enjoyable. We felt taken care of the entire time, and it made my mom’s birthday trip that much more memorable. I would absolutely stay here again and highly recommend it to anyone looking for a chic, clean, and welcoming place to stay in Miami. 💛

Stayed 2 nights in a standard room on 8th floor overlooking the main entrance. While the hotel has some positives, particularly the housekeeping, the high level of road noise 24/7 was an issue. The main road is basically an extended I-4 on/off ramp, and the traffic lights in front of the hotel effectively a starting grid. Every green light was like a speedway. Even ear plugs had no chance. Poor location and a large window design which didn’t appear to help. Would not return.

hotel_name: Brickell Arch, A Luxury Collection Hotel, Miami
review_text: When the sticker price for a basic queen room is $600 plus, why do you need to sneak “destination fees” onto to my bill? AKA does not tell you about the destination fees until you check out ($100 per day). Want to check in early? $100 fee (this was $75 fee last time we stayed here). The hotel was transitioning to Marriot brand on my last day so the breakfast service was extremely limited due to “system issue”. Only toast and fruit at the “Michelin chef” restaurant. Booked a massage for 9am. Got there at 8:50am and waited until 9:15am until I gave up. Eventually got a call at 9:30am w the spa manager acting as though she had been at the spa desk the whole time only to eventually admit she was caught in traffic. I did end up getting my “80 minute massage” but it was only 65 minutes of actual massage time. My shower was out of conditioner and body wash. I called down for a replacement and it never came. I travel to Miami often for work and will do my best to avoid AKA brickell or whatever it will be rebranded too under marriot ownership.

My wife and I are in our sixties. We arrived early afternoon and were offered a room on the second floor. When we asked for another room on the lower level we were told the hotel was booked up. The air conditioner could not cool the room. We requested service three times. The hotel employee would come to the room and play with the remote until the air came out cool. After they left the AC would stop working. It was an uncomfortable night.

The Vagabond was awesome. Vibes were immaculate, the pool was incredible. Room was nicely decorated and had everything I needed. The staff was most exceptional. They really made me feel like a valued guest, took care of all my needs, and it was clear they enjoyed getting to know their guests. There are also several amazing restaurants within a block of the hotel. Would definitely recommend!

This COULD be a great hotel. The staff is truly nice, the rooms are relatively clean and the hotel property is stunning. But issues which are unfortunate make it impossible to give this hotel a better review. They include a serious issue with hot water. Every member of our party had the same in their room every day we stayed and ended up taking cold showers. Clearly a pervasive issue and so unacceptable. The rooms are also too dark with inadequate overall lighting. The bathroom also needed an illuminating mirror. Finally, the elevators are too complex and you end up waiting constantly and need an engineering degree to use them. Could be a much better hotel. But someone needs to dial into the details!

The retro, mid-century vibe, both in the rooms and throughout the property, gave it so much personality, and my room was very comfortable and clean. Each morning, I’d head to the lobby for a cup of coffee, chat with people there, and then make my way to the charming pool area. In the evenings, my friend and I would relax on the loungers before calling it a night. The hotel team also had great recommendations, and transit was easy for getting to much of what I wanted to see in Miami. I’m already looking forward to coming back, especially once the restaurant is open, though there was still plenty within walking distance.

After reading recent bad reviews we had to do our own to say we completely disagree as we loved this hotel! 10 night stay with adult kids (22 and 19) and we all had a great time. Yes the road is a little noisy in the mornings but it certainly didn’t keep us awake during the night. The room and bathroom was spotless and cleaned every other day where they left fresh towels, emptied bins and brushed/ mopped the floors. Always smelt fresh after they had been in. We had adjoining skyline 2 queen bed rooms which can sleep 4 and even though had 2 people in each room we were left four towels, hand towels and face cloths so there was always a spare. Really don’t understand peoples problem with housekeeping every other day - you are out at the parks 8 to 10 hours a day so it’s not hard to keep your room tidy! All the staff were lovely and friendly. The food in the urban pantry was excellent. Highly recommend the wok bowls, the burgers and pizza station. Lots of choice for breakfast - cooked items and hot sandwiches, croissants, doughnuts, cereal pots, fruit and fruit pots, and a Starbucks with all their usual breakfast options. Location for the parks was fantastic. It’s not advertised by staff but you can walk just next door to sapphire falls and use the water taxi to get to Universal and Islands of Adventure with security on the dock so you avoid the big queues at the main entrance security. We used the shuttle bus to get to epic - very frequent reliable service- never had to wait more than 5 to 10 mins. Also a walking path to volcano bay from the back of the pool area. Didn’t use the pool as were too busy in the parks but area looked nice and clean and good shaded seating area by the pool bar. This hotel is not aimed at families with very young children but that’s exactly why we chose it as it was more chilled and quiet and no kids running around corridors or banging doors that you get in the bigger more themed hotels. We loved it and would definitely stay there again.

We had a great experience staying at the Universal Aventura Hotel. We walked to both Universal Studios and Islands of Adventures (we chose to walk rather than waiting for the water taxi). It was convenient being able to leave whenever we want and walk to the parks. The day we went to Epic it was easy to take the shuttle from the hotel. And Volcano Bay was so close! We enjoyed staying at the hotel itself - we liked the minimal vibe. The room worked well for our family of 3 (king bed and pull out couch). We only bought breakfast in the hotel and drinks at the bar so can't comment on the restaurant. Pool and rooftop bar were nice, as was the staff. Our daughter loved seeing the robot in the hotel. We would definitely stay here again.

We had a fun, spacious room very clean too) for a great price. And parking was included too! Though it’s not in the center of sightseeing spots, there are a lot of good restaurants nearby (We We’s Bistro and the outstanding Nido Caffe for Italian) and a beautiful pool area.

We loved our stay at this hotel. It was so convenient for the parks. Rooms were clean,spacious and well equipped, beds were comfortable. Rooms were cleaned and serviced every other day. The hotel has a canteen/ grab and go type restaurant where you could order food to eat in or there were lots of take out sandwiches,fruit & snacks to go, it was nice to have the choice. There is also a pizza oven where you can get pizzas made fresh to eat in or take away. There is also a Starbucks. As this is a universal hotel you can also eat next door at sapphire falls, which was more of a formal dining experience. The swimming pool area was nice, but we didn’t use as weather wasn’t really warm enough. We used to walk to sapphire falls to get the water taxi into the park, but you can also walk there in about 15 mins along the side of the canal which the water taxis use. We also enjoyed sitting up in the rooftop bar 17 where you can enjoy food and drinks. Sometimes you can be lucky to catch the firework displays in the distance from Disney and Epcot. We thoroughly enjoyed our stay and would definitely stay again.

Great staff! But don’t stay there unless you want to hear Club music from next store pumping till 3am. Rooms are not at all sound proof. Restaurant up top was great! As was pool. But for this price point we wanted some sleep!

Vancances at the arlo hotel with my husband we had was captivated by the decoration of a very great elegance and even has very modern time. The bar the restaurant are as much a treat of the eyes and taste buds the staff of great kindness smiling at the listen and even if we do not speak English they all do to help us. The pool heat on you with the bar. The music on top 😊 thank you on c is feasted. Geraldine and Stephan

I recently stayed at Arlo Hotel Wynwood with my husband and kids and the experience was extremely disappointing. There were very loud events happening at the hotel and the noise level was completely out of control. People were screaming and the music was so loud that it was impossible to relax in our room. When you stay at a hotel with your family you expect at least a basic level of comfort and quiet, but that was not the case here. For the price they charge, the experience simply does not match the cost. The service was also disappointing and the staff did not seem concerned about the situation or the impact on guests who were trying to rest. Overall it felt like a waste of both time and money. If you are looking for a peaceful stay, especially with family, I would not recommend this hotel. Unfortunately this was one of the worst hotel experiences we’ve had.

hotel_name: Brickell Arch, A Luxury Collection Hotel, Miami
review_text: I can not believe how badly the property is managed now. I have a 2 week stay at the hotel for business and basically every other day there is some annoying issue: -TV remote is broken -No room service QR code or menu: I asked the front desk about it, they said they will bring a QR plaque for the menu, but nothing happened. I already asked 3 times at the front desk they always say they will put it into the room but after the 3rd time i just gave up -After using the Laundry service, they did not provide me with additional Laundry Bags or form. I asked at the front desk on my way to work if they could put some into the room... nothing there in the evening. Then i called the Front desk again, and they said they will immediately bring some. The bags did arrive but no forms for the laundry. -The glass shower door is falling apart and can not properly close. This is quite dangerous as it can shatter. I've told the front desk on multiple occasions that it's broken, on the 3rd day now. Maybe today is different. -Room cleaning staff left a bottle of their cleaner in the bathroom and took a bottle of my aftershave for some reason? -Once I called the room service number and they would just not pick up for several minutes until it reached some automated answering machine.

Worked with the staff to make a surprise for my brother and his fiancee and they went above and beyond! So grateful to them for their true hospitality and help. Quick response, kindness, and efficiency. Shout out to Alejandro Ponce for stellar work
Great hotel with great staff. Love the vibe of the neighborhood!!! Will be back

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites Miami Wynwood Design District
review_text: Front desk staff was awesome ! I arrived very early and Eric was able to accommodate me and provide a fantastic room . Super friendly and very helpful !

Really delightful small hotel, completely renovated. Clean, well-decorated; great pool and pool area with its little bar. Very friendly and helpful staff, from management to front desk to housekeeping. Some good restaurants within one block, easy walk. We stay before cruising, and only a very easy and short drive to the port. Note: be careful and book directly; the first sites that come up on search are not the Vagabond's site.

Room was amazing and everything about a 2-3night stay was amazing. However, the wedding guests were terribly loud and rowdy until after 4am. Im surprised that type of disruption was allowed on property so late. The previous night was okay, no issues. Close to some major spots and hotel amenities are great. Stayed in a suite!

Although the location is interesting for its proximity to the various theme parks and the room is clean and spacious, the service was not up to standard. The staff went every two days to the rooms and soap was missing. I had to help myself. I still put two stars, because not only were the prices for food exorbitant, but when we pay at the counter for check-in especially the payment machine offers to pay either in US or CAN. I had selected in CAN of course, because in February 2026 1$ US was worth 1.37$ CAN. When I received my invoice the following week when I arrived, I realized that the company had finally loaded me in US. I contacted the company by email, they replied that it was impossible to pay in CAN on their properties. I replied that their machine offered a choice. They further replied that their properties did not accept CAN payments. Beware of hotels that promise to attract a clientele by offering them the advantage of paying in CAN currency in particular, but ultimately reject it altogether. Until then, don't offer this method of payment. It's just a tourist catcher.

I had an amazing time staying at the Arlo Wynwood. The staff were amazing with a special shout out to Julian for his excellent hospitality. The rooftop pool was very nice and the food and drinks were excellent
Able and Joseph could not have been more attentive or friendly. They made sure we had everything we needed. Perfect days by the pool.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites Miami Wynwood Design District
review_text: Checked in and Torri at the front desk was great. She went out of her way to find me a phone charger and personally delivered it to my room. Thank you again Torri for your first class hospitality.
Lovely hotel but not worth the price ..good location but very very overpriced for a room on the first floor….

I love the staff at this hotel! We had a little hiccup with our room when we arrived and Ozzy was above and beyond with kindness and help for us. What a wonderful individual! During our stay, David helped me more than once and he was just an incredible human being. Love the atrium and the style of our room! Great location to shops, restaurants, even the movie theater! We felt very safe here and were actually attending my favorite cousin’s wedding reception and activities for the weekend. We had so much fun on the rooftop relaxing after the hectic plans all weekend! Thank you again for a perfect stay.

This IS a funky little hotel...more like the motor inns of yesteryear. They have done a great job of creating a 60's vibe. The rooms are basic and clean with groovy wall art. Bathrooms are terrific, as is the shower. We also stayed pre cruise but with construction around it took a little longer getting to the port. Lots of restaurants around. The pool is great as is the outdoor sitting area. Bar was getting renovated so not open at the time...but my guess is that it would fit the atmosphere. Staff was very good too!

We stayed at the Vagabond for 5 nights from Friday to Wednesday. The hotel is in the middle of the Miami Modern (Mimo) district in super close distance to amazing restaurants with many breakfast options (like Caracas Bakery) and Dinner options as well, and close enough to North Beach (12 minutes). The hotel has been fully renovated and it is extremely clean (spotless rooms and hotel in general). The rooms are spacious and we love the decor and furniture. A true boutique hotel. The pool is amazing and great to spend a full day since the water in the pool is warmth at all times! It has enough pool beds, chais, and tables for a great set up. There is no pool bar or restaurant, but you can bring your own beverages and snacks to the pool. The staff, from maintenance to room keepers to the reception desk, was exceptional and very helpful at all times with all request. They pay attention to all details and drive for best customer service with all our questions and requests. You also get 2 bottles of water everyday and also free parking in front of the property or around the property. We just LOVED IT and can’t wait to come back to the Vagabond Hotel soon!!!

We stayed here for 5 nights in a room with 2 x double beds. The room is clean and has everything you need for a good stay. The room is serviced every other day with new towels etc. I do wish they also included shower gel as opposed to a bar of soap but that is just personal preference. All the staff are helpful and we enjoyed the Starbucks downstairs for breakfast. The staff there are also very friendly. The buses to the parks are frequent or you can go through Sapphire Falls Hotel to the ferry. We would recommend this hotel and would stay again.

I stayed at the beautiful Hyde Hotel in Midtown. There was an issue with my towels. I left makeup on them. The hotel thought it was something else. I spoke with George and he provided me with a credit after speaking with him. He understood it was make up. The hotel is amazing with beautiful views and location is in walking distance to all restaurants and shopping. I would definitely stay at this hotel again. I will bring my own makeup towel next time.

Where do I begin — our stay at the Arlo Wynwood was a 10/10. The majority of that rating is due to the amazing front desk team. Specifically Oscar, Fabiola and Savory. Check in was a breeze and they went above and beyond to help us in any capacity. We will only stay at the Arlo when we are in Miami, I recommend you do the same!
Clean room, great location Talk to George. He'll be happy to help you.

I rarely write reviews, but my experience at the Aventura Resort Orlando was unacceptable and needs to be shared. During my stay, my Louis Vuitton belt was taken from my room. What followed was even more concerning than the incident itself. I was passed between nearly 20 different staff members across security, front desk, and lost & found — with no ownership, no clear communication, and no resolution. At multiple points, I was told “we’ll make this right,” only to later be told that because there is “no proof,” nothing can be done. That response is not only dismissive, but it completely ignores the responsibility a property has to its guests. The issue here is bigger than a missing item — it’s the complete lack of professionalism, accountability, and basic customer care. When a guest raises a serious concern involving potential theft, the expectation is a coordinated, thoughtful response. Instead, I experienced deflection, inconsistency, and zero follow-through. For a hospitality business in a major market like Orlando, this is unacceptable. I would strongly caution others to think twice before staying here — not because issues can’t happen anywhere, but because how they are handled here falls far below any reasonable standard.

Excellent service! I attended a party on the 3rd floor and had an emergency in the restrooms; Mariela, the overnight cleaning staff member, helped me every step of the way. She is a very generous young woman.

We have stayed many times at the Vagabond Motel over the years visiting our daughter and grandson in Miami. Many of our family have also had excellent stays at different times at the Vagabond. The pool is clean and lovely with comfortable lounge chairs around and beach towels provided. The rooms are quiet and airy, and the decor is beautiful. The staff are always very friendly and helpful; highly recommended. Excellent restaurants and a great bakery are just a few steps away.

This is a beautiful hotel in a great area. For what we paid, their failure to better communicate + other things, was inexcusable. A lot of little things that added up. The joke, as I will explain, was that during our stay they texted and asked how things were going. I replied not so good and they asked why. I said happy to chat when back to hotel and then let them know I was back but no followup. I even showed the front desk person the texts. He could have cared less. When we checked in we were told because of how we booked, we got comp bf and also 2 drinks plus a $100 hotel credit. We had arrived late after a long day of travel. We were hungry and while we dont usually munch from the mini-bar, we were ready for a snack. Unfortunately, of the 10 or so food items there were supposed to be there, there was only 1. So no snack. We then went up to the roof top bar and sat down at 850. We looked at the food menu and first tried to order a couple beers with our drink coupons. They were out of about half the beers. People were eating around us. At 910, we told the bartender we wanted to order some food. He aid sorry, kitchen closed at 900. WHY COULDNT HE HAVE TOLD US THAT WHEN WE SAT DOWN! He said their main restaurant was open to 945. We decided to get room service. I tried to call couple times from the bar and just got vm. Frustrating. We were forced to go down to the restaurant and order directly from them. Had similar issue calling valet. Just rang and rang and rang. Finally front desk answered.Also, forgot to mention that in the room the toilet seat was loose. Annoying, especially when using it during the night. The room has a double sink (nice) but no dedicated soap dispenser. We had to move the soap dispenser from the shower to the sink and back. They had hand lotion but had to be 100 yers old. Came out in solid chunks. Disgusting. We crashed around mid-night. Poor sleep for 2 reasons. The hotel has an open atrium and we heard noises (loud) well after midnight- yelling, laughing. I was too tired to get out of bed and call but cant believe the hotel didn’t hear. Plus, the hallways are tiled, meaning you hear anything that is being wheeled over it. WE woke up around 900. I noticed on a flyer that they were serving brunch till 200 so figured we could shower and then head down for bf. We got to the restaurant about 1015 and were told sorry, bf ends at 1000. Nothing they could or would do other than get us 2 coffees (no machines in the rooms). Again, at check-in we should have been told this. We needed ice and called and they said would be right up. To me that means 5 minutes, maybe 10 if you tell someone “right up.” 15 minutes nothing. We were tired of waiting and called back and said to just leave it in the room since we were on our way out. Don’t promise something if cant deliver. Finally, as noted above, if you actually cared about how our stay was going, they would have responded to the text they sent me or the guy at reception would actually care we weren’t happy. Im happy to share with hotel the name of the person who texted us asking how the stay was going

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites Miami Wynwood Design District
review_text: I had an outstanding experience, thanks to both Brandon and Tori! Brandon did an excellent job recommending the hotel-his suggestion was absolutely perfect and exceeded my expectations in every way. You can tell he truly cares about making sure guests have the best possible experience. Tori was equally amazing during the check-in process. She was warm, welcoming, and incredibly helpful, making everything smooth and stress-free. Her professionalism and friendly attitude made a great first impression and set the tone for a wonderful stay. Together, Brandon and Tori provided top-notch service that truly stood out. I'm very grateful for their help and would highly recommend this team to anyone!

After a long day of travel, we couldn’t have asked for a warmer welcome than the one we received at the AC Hotel Wynwood. From the moment we walked in, Sameerah, the front desk manager, set the tone for our entire stay with her energy, warmth, and genuine hospitality. Sameerah greeted us with a full walkthrough of the hotel’s amenities and surprised us with a thoughtful welcome that included chocolate, bottled water, and a glass of rosé. She then went above and beyond to take care of everything we needed: helping us plan breakfast for the next morning and arranging a shuttle to the port the following day. She handled it all cheerfully and made sure our family left the front desk feeling completely taken care of. That kind of attentive, personal service is rare, and it gave us an incredible first impression of the property. Our fifth floor room was everything we hoped for after a tiring travel day: spacious, quiet, clean, and thoughtfully laid out. As a family of three, we had plenty of room to spread out and get comfortable. The efficient layout made the space feel even larger than it was. If you’re considering a stay at the AC Hotel Wynwood, do yourself a favor and book it. Between the beautiful accommodations and staff like Sameerah who truly go the extra mile, this hotel delivers an experience that is hard to top. We will absolutely be back!

I regret not coming sooner! We are so impressed with the friendly staff, beautiful decor, delicious food and drinks, and relaxing but fun atmosphere. The rooftop pool and bar/restaurant is such a lovely experience. It’s also a wonderful location in Coconut Grove. Close to everything! We will absolutely return the Mayfair in the future!

This was an excellent hotel in a great location. Front desk staff George & Billy were so helpful and great to recommend places to eat, etc. Beautiful room and great amenities. Very close to the cruise port and that was great for the morning we checked out. We will definitely book this hotel again if we are in Miami.
Location, neighbor and vale service 5/5 Crew 4/5 Housekeeping 1/5 (sometimes they skip room cleaning and when they do it's not completely done)

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites Miami Wynwood Design District
review_text: My recent stay at this hotel was my fourth stay. As usual the front desk staff were very helpful and the room was comfortable and clean. A big special thanks to Enrique who changed the battery in my suitcase weighing scales for me.
Had a great time, service was top notch. Thank you valet Alejandro for being so attentive.

Delighted of all the service, I went to visit from Spain, in the valet parking of the night I was attended by a boy named Alejandro Rivas, delighted with the attention that I provide to me and my sister, very friendly the boy, the service 5 stars.

hotel_name: Brickell Arch, A Luxury Collection Hotel, Miami
review_text: Last week, we had breakfast at Mare restaurant amidst a tense and difficult situation due to Micros system in the restaurant was not functioning, checks could not be printed or closed, but the breakfast Manager (Leandro) every moment reflected high professionalism and refined attention. He created such a positive reliable environment, he even used his Phone to take screenshots of the checks and showed them to those of us who were there, our kudos and deepest gratitude to him.

We moved across to this hotel after staying at the Royal pacific and were pleasantly surprised how good this hotel was! We had a double queen deluxe room - which had a panoramic window and a fab view! We were the Cabana bay side and was lucky enough to see the Magic Kingdom fireworks! Rooms were a good size - we liked the shower cubicle better than the bath with over shower and curtain in the Royal pacific! There is a small fridge. The rooftop was great for an early evening drink and watching the sunset or just stay in your room and watch it set! Food was ok - we had noodles, pizza and again stayed in our room or you can eat in the dining area! It seemed very quiet! Slight cons - paper cups rather than glasses and not a great deal of storage (we only stayed a night so wasn’t an issue) the pool was ok - nothing special - the water was freezing! But there was a hot tub to warm up! We stayed here for the close proximity to Volcano Bay! All in all I would recommend this hotel for a short stay while visiting universal!

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites Miami Wynwood Design District
review_text: We had a horrible experience at a different hotel and ended up here at 9pm looking for vacancy. Brandon was so nice and on top of everything. The hotel smelled clean upon walk in and the room itself was clean and comfortable. We were so glad with the decision to leave our booked hotel and find this place. Brandon was friendly, professional and so helpful to not only me but the people who came in after us while I was there. I would highly recommend this hotel.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
