review_text: Exceeded my expectations! Location is amazing! Walking distance from best places in Downtown Miami! Breakfast was superior in quality : real cheese and charcuterie among the selections! Room was big with a jacuzzi! Everything went so well in my 2 nights stay! The cherry on the cake is Ernest, the manager! He is caring, attentive and courteous! I have one tiny complaint! I am a cheese lover who hate vegetables! Please, dont put cheese and broccoli in the same tray!( breakfast)!

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: I’ve stayed at this location many times for business. They are always so warm and welcoming. I had an issue at check in recently and Rassoul went above and beyond to help me. His customer service is impeccable and I am forever a Hilton traveler because of people like Rassoul.

We got a free upgrade so that was nice! The rooms could have been cleaner. We found a previous guest's lingerie stuffed inside one of the drawers. But overall it was a great stay and I would definitely recommend it.

We had a fantastic stay at the Arlo, the rooms were spotless, the facilities modern and easily accessible. The staff were particularly helpful and I want to commend both Oscar and Wanda at the front desk for their hospitality - they made our stay memorable and I truly appreciated their attitude to service.
Oscar at the front desk was seriously the best!! So welcoming, so nice, and just made everything feel easy from the second I walked in.

Very unprofessional and not worth the money they charge in my opinion… Ressort fee will be additionally charged per day for WiFi, water and pool. Water is not in the room in the promised amount and also not restocked. Coffee capsules same… you have to call them for every single thing - even if you want your towels changed

The hotel is very modern and hip. The suite was absolutely perfect and finally a bathroom that had lighting that actually works for applying makeup. I usually have to sit on the floor with a small mirror on window sill to get ready because other hotels bathrooms are lit like a cave. The location in Midtown is awesome. It’s an up and coming area in Miami and has an easy vibe with many great restaurants within walking distance of hotel. It also feels safe. Price was surprisingly low. Especially still being at the end of our season in Florida

Fantastic place to stay in Miami! Lovely staff, great pool area and clean rooms Just got a nice feel to the place. Very helpful staff, especially Kris who went out of his way to be helpful. Will defo be back whenever in Miami

hotel_name: Brickell Arch, A Luxury Collection Hotel, Miami
review_text: Overall, a fantastic experience with a Breakfast team, the service was absolutely excellent, especially Julianna and Jessica were very sweet and kind . Special mention to Leandro, who made a point of greeting us properly, no just a quick hello, but real eye contact, and often a short conversation, he made the whole experience feel personal rather transactional.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: Great facility, nice functional in downtown Miami brickell. Conveniently located to public transport that in Miami are convenient and free. Friendly and helpful staff. Good breakfast. Clean.

We stayed at this hotel for ten nights during a busy time. Check in was simple and Tina on the front desk was extremely helpful friendly and even gave us a generous treat when we checked in. Our room was on the 14th floor and had a view of the universal parks. The rooms were clean and the only problem we had was our tablet that controlled the rooms lights wouldn’t charge when we arrived but was sorted within an hour of going out for essentials. The buses to the parks were regular and the boat across the road in Sapphire Falls was very easy to use and great access to the parks. We had a few lunches in the hotel and the food was well priced for the quality and convenience. I stayed here with my 13 year old daughter and we would both stay here again!

I had a wonderful experience at the hotel. We arrived quite late due to traffic and we were very well received by the reception. There was coffee available, parking facilitated a lot and the room was extremely clean. The exterior area is a grace, very nice and gave us the desire to stay for more days to enjoy it. The staff was very kind, gave us tips and wanted to present us with mimos from Brazil :) We recommend closed eyes!

The Original Historically Renowned Rat Pack Hangout in Miami! We've stayed at The Vagabond Motel pre-cruise the past 2 years. What a find this was! And, it's close to both the airport , cruise port, and many restaurants within walking distance. The rooms are fabulous, fun & very retro if you like that vibe! The pool is huge & the entire property is beautiful and immaculate. The property was originally a popular hangout for the Rat Pack (Frank Sinatra, Dean Martin, and Sammy Davis Jr.) in the 50's & the remodel mirrors this era in a fun, relaxing, retro vibe. The Vagabond Motel was added to the National Register of Historical Places in 2014. A placard is prominently displayed near the front of the Motel with a brief history of its architectural style and relevancy in Miami's evolving deterioration and rebuilding of the MiMo area through community support. See more here: https://www.selectedbyrg.com/blog/vagabondmotel

Love the retro vibe. Room was well appointed and clean. Staff were all polite. Lots of spots to eat nearby, and front desk staff had great suggestions for things to do in the area. A little noise from the pool area but overall a quiet stay. This property feels like a private oasis.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites Miami Wynwood Design District
review_text: We had a fantastic stay at this hotel with our family of four. The location was perfect. Close to the cruise port, which made our travel day easy and stress-free. From the moment we arrived, the atmosphere was welcoming and relaxing, setting the tone for a great experience. The amenities were wonderful. Complementary breakfast. The pool area was beautiful and a great place to unwind. Our room was clean/well-maintained, and we were comfortable the entire stay. What truly made this stay exceptional, though, was the staff. Every single person we interacted with was friendly, accommodating, and genuinely welcoming. A very special shoutout to Eric at the front desk. He was hands down the kindest person we have ever met. He patiently answered every question we had and never once made us feel rushed. His warmth and helpfulness made such a lasting impression on us. Eric was truly the star of this place, and honestly, we would return just to see him again! We can’t recommend this hotel enough and are already looking forward to our next stay.

hotel_name: Brickell Arch, A Luxury Collection Hotel, Miami
review_text: From the very first moment, we were enveloped in a sense of comfort and refined hospitality. This remarkable experience was shaped not only by the gracious, attentive, and genuinely welcoming presence of the manager, Leandro, but also by the impeccable service throughout. The stunning bay views, exquisite cuisine, and serene, sophisticated ambiance come together seamlessly to create a truly unforgettable destination.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites Miami Wynwood Design District
review_text: Victoria was amazing! She was super accommodating with a last minute booking!
been there and it was very nice..

hotel_name: Brickell Arch, A Luxury Collection Hotel, Miami
review_text: Mare Restaurant is situated on the 25th floor of what is now the Marriott Luxury Hotel, formerly the AKA Hotel. My husband and I are banking professionals based in the Brickell area, and we have dined at Mare for lunch on numerous occasions. It's certainly no coincidence that the Manager is actively involved in every detail from offering a warm welcome and crafting a delicious Aperol Spritz to cleaning plates from a table and preparing an exquisite Cuban Coffee, without a doubt, Leandro is a King, but without a crown. Many Leandro's are needed in the hospitality industry. We, the satisfied guests, placed the crown.

The one thing better than the food is the service and the view. And that’s hard to say because everything is beyond amazing. Daniela made us feel so special, suggested the best options for our experience and was on top of every little detail. She told us about brunch and we can’t wait to try it
The hotel is in a very convenient location. Close to the airport and a short drive to the beach. Great pool!

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: This hotel checked all our boxes: near public transportation, restaurants and shopping. Rooms were well thought out - and really appreciated the laundry facilities.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites Miami Wynwood Design District
review_text: On March 25, 2026, family stayed at Hampton Inn & Suites Miami Wynwood Design District overnight departing for a cruise the next day. During our stay, we encountered Eric. Eric truly gave the best customer service we've ever experienced. Eric was very helpful, considerate, polite, accommodating and just down right nice. It was truly an honor to experience that level of kindness because in today's world, it's very hard to find. So, kudos to Eric and thank you for putting the "H" in hospitality. Truly Thankful, The Teague & Nunn Families
Fantastic time. Great food! Nice people!
Amazing food and great atmosphere! Dani is the best server there, she super nice and attentive
Excellent service! Daniela was spectacular. She had so much knowledge about the food and drinks. Will definitely come back to this place. Well worth the price and the ambiance was magnificent.
Atmosphere and food is top tier, Dani was so nice and always looking out for the table.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: How much is a family room and the location and time to bake

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: Great location in Brickell—close to everything and just a block from the train, which made getting around really easy. Breakfast was simple, standard complimentary options, but did the job. What really stood out was the service, especially from Netch A. We arrived very early after a long trip and were exhausted—she went above and beyond to get us into a room as soon as possible. The room she selected was perfect and gave us exactly what we needed to rest and ease into our anniversary trip. It’s also conveniently close to the cruise port, and they offer shuttle service which was a big plus. We’d definitely stay here again and would recommend it to others.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: Very good hotel. This is the second time we stayed here. We were welcomed by Laicka excellent customer service. He explained everything in detail. Congratulations!!

My teenage daughter and I stayed her for a week in her Easter holidays. The hotel was great for the price, good rooms, fab top floor bar/restaurant, convenient pizza on the GF and the pool was also great. All in all a great time. My 1 star is because the day I returned, the hotel took money for my stay despite me paying up front for the holiday through UK tour operator Thomas Cook. The hotel conceded the error, but refunded me a lessor amount. Initial good communication has now ceased. I’m posting the 1 star with the aim of getting my full refund.

Location/ Area has changed since my last visit, not hotels fault. Atmosphere - Employee was very accommodating at check-in. The room we got needs a refresher, with stains on the bed's headboard and sticky remote to name a few. For the price point we would've expected more. The atmosphere was okay, however leaves a lot room for improvement. Cleanliness room needs a deep clean, the small details add up. We weren't in the room long enough to report back about noise levels.

Alro is the top choice for staying in Miami. Ernesto operates the best valet service. I only trust him with my car. Oscar at the front desk sent over a bottle of champagne for our anniversary, top notch service. 10/10 with the Arlo

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites Miami Wynwood Design District
review_text: Very good hotel, good service, clean and excellent location

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: I’m sorry we were only able to stay less than 24 hours. The hotel is conveniently located next to and walking distance from a lot of restaurants and shops and the metro. The room was a good size, comfortable and clean. The customer service was awesome. The breakfast was leagues ahead of any Hilton brand I have ever stayed at, and the person in charge kept the area very clean and stocked, and they have plenty of indoor and outdoor seating. Other locations please take note. It obviously can be done!! One additional perk that was perfect for us was the noon checkout instead of 11:00. We don’t usually travel to Miami, but I recommend this hotel to anyone needing a place to stay in the area.

hotel_name: Brickell Arch, A Luxury Collection Hotel, Miami
review_text: If you enjoy opening a window from the minute you step in, you know you are somewhere special. Manager(Leandro) ultra focused on service wonderful restaurant, calm, peaceful, gorgeous interiors, light music, if you have a table on the balcony terrace, you breathe the air of Biscayne Bay.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: I visit family in Miami on a regular basis, and Hampton has become my go-to hotel. Conveniently located, always clean, and excellent service. The breakfast is a really useful perk as well. On this stay, I'd like to commend Rassoul who was particularly helpful after a stressful trip, due to train delays because of North Florida wildfires, and Rassoul was very understanding, concerned and attentive. Will be back soon!

Hydr Midtown was great stay all around! Guest services helped decorate my room for a birthday surprise, the valet service was seamless, and the amenities beneficial bonuses on top of my stay. The WhatsApp communication was also superb! 10/10 stay!!

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: We had a one-night stay prior to a cruise. The hotel was clean, modern, and well maintained. The room was equipped with fridge, microwave, and a coffee machine that took some time to figure out. Check in on the sixth floor wasn’t a problem and elevator access any higher required a key card. Breakfast was included and the usual continental plus a few hot options. Staff was helpful storing our early arrival bags until our room was ready. There was an excellent restaurant right at the entrance and a bar in the front desk area. We were able to book a shuttle to our ship right on the ground floor for a reasonable price and that service was good. Our only disappointment was the pool being closed without explanation.

Hotel complex is larger than you think! Do not stay in Building B, facing I4. Very, very noisy. I had to move to Building C. Lot of Families. Sports bar is small, definitely could make this 2 or 3 times larger. Coffee shop and little shop are nice, has most essentials. Front desk and Security staff is awesome! I moved my room and forgot my uniforms in the old room closet! Security & cleaning staff had them in the office all bagged up for me! Pools looked cleaned and area around buildings clean & well lit. Great location and price is best deal. Have stayed here several times. Sports bar burger and fries for $13, best deal in Town & yummy! You have to place order at bar counter, see signs. They'll bring to your table. Limited seating, like said, could / should be enlarged. Parking is convenient and cheap compared to others.

We had a very nice stay before a cruise. A convenient location with beautiful views of the cruise port, and walking distance to restaurants and a grocery store to stock up on last minute items. We really appreciated having access to our room when we arrive (approximately 11:30) instead of needing to wait until around 3:00 like so many hotels make you do. That courtesy is enough to make us book there again!! At the reception desk Flo was very helpful.

The rooms are insanely loud. You can hear everything happening in the rooms on either side of you and in the halls. The shower was lukewarm, at best. It’s a cool boutique vibe but I would never stay here again.

Interesting motel in MIMO district--15 minutes or so from Miami Beach and Miami downtown. Great service--free coffee and chips. Would have loved to have a mini refriderator in the room I realize that this is not "retro" but it helps with doggy bags and drinks.

Great stay and very convenient location to our family and friends in downtown Miami and Miami Shores. Super friendly staff - shout out to Linda for the laughs. Room was comfortable and clean, and we appreciated the complimentary coffee in the lobby. Pro Tip: Until they open the restaurant, walk next door to the Caracas Bakery for fantastic pastries, breakfast toasts and lattes. Bring them back and enjoy poolside!

Beautiful - Comfortable - Quiet - VERY Clean! My mom, sister and I were there last weekend for one night. We were beyond pleased with The Vagabond. We will definitely return. The staff was very friendly and helpful. And location - excellent restaurants and bakery just next door. It's like an oasis in the middle of Mi-Mo. The pool area is nicely appointed with areas to either sit in the sun or shade. We shared a bottle of wine poolside (the small party store next door has a great selection). The rooms are nicely appointed and comfortable.

We have just spent 2 nights at the Aventura hotel at Universal and had a very nice experience. The rooms were big enough and the beds just a nice level of firmness for us but the view (in a higher floor room) was just great. We could've sat and looked out over the parks all day. We ate at the lobby cafe and it was good. We also had a cocktail at the bar at the top of the hotel and the views were exceptional (well worth a visit). The staff we experienced were all good and the location (next to Sapphire Falls) makes getting to City Walk etc a pleasure. The only potential downside is that buses to Epic are shared with Cabana Bay and can get rather busy. Overall 8/10 but 10/10 for value. Highly recommended.
Fabulous boutique hotel with beautiful pool area and nicely updated rooms. Well equipped, clean rooms.
Amazing experience as always! George was very polite both in the check in and check out.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites Miami Wynwood Design District
review_text: Very good stay — with big credit to Alberte and her excellent customer service skills. The hotel itself is very nice, the location is near the lively design district and I didn’t experience any rudeness. Hot water supply was excellent. The rooms themselves could use the work hence the four stars. A bit of carpet would brinf soke needed warmth. Ither thsn that, a surprisingly good experience. Thank you Alberte. Tammy feom Ohio.
Great location, modern room decor.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites Miami Wynwood Design District
review_text: First time in Miami, and did not like our first choice of hotel after arriving at 10:30pm. We quickly searched and found the Hampton Inn. I spoke to Brandon St Gerard and he was polite and professional as he explained our options, and had 2 rooms left for the length of our stay. We quickly booked the room and he greeted us upon arrival. His kindness and assistance reduced our stress level. Our room is pleasant and clean.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: Absolutely amazing hotel stay before my cruise. This hotel is clean, convenient to shopping and plenty of restaurants/bars. Walking distance to a Publix, the mall, bakery, etc. The hotel checkin is on the 6th floor, the first floor is mainly a seating area and concierge. They offer free hot breakfast, mini fridge and microwave in the room, cruise shuttle at time of this review is priced at $12 with pick up times at 10a, 11a, and 12p. If you miss breakfast, they had breakfast bags with fruit and other grab and go items. You will need your room key to access the laundry room and guest floors. There is no carpet in the room I was in (basic king- not the elite level) and pets are not allowed. Service animals only. The hotel has a lobby bar, three restaurants are located right next door (Sproutz, Batch Gastropub, and Shahs of Kabob). I dined at Sproutz and Shahas of Kabob and both are good, but they are not affiliated with the hotel. I stayed 3 nights prior to my cruise and I really enjoyed my stay. The air conditioner worked with no issues, pillows are very soft, bed was firm, but not uncomfortable and I slept better in that bed, than my own. There is a master light switch to control the overhead light in the entry and bathroom. You can operate them separately (it just takes some flipping of lights to figure it out). Decent water pressure and nice, hot water at night. Morning time I suggest getting your shower in early. Hot water is still present but not as hot as it was the night before. Tip- I took my shower at 5/6am the morning of checkout and the water was hot and perfect for a nice shower before leaving for cruise. Staff was always smiling, friendly and willing to assist. Carlos at the concerige desk is very helpful, ask for his recommendations and he is more than happy to assist. The 7th floor has the laundry facility, but many machines were out of order. This is going on my pre cruise hotel list because it was the perfect hotel and the perfect location. It was about a 15min ride to the cruise port and airport. The cruise port ride was booked for 8am, so I beat the 9am bumper car cruise port traffic.

hotel_name: Brickell Arch, A Luxury Collection Hotel, Miami
review_text: I like staying in Brickell when I visit Miami and this is the first time I stayed at this property. I will not stay here again. The elevator system requires guests to take 2 elevators to get to rooms. That is incredibly annoying and time consuming. That was enough to turn me off but, in addition, the staff did not seem to care about guests. As an example, I waited 15 minutes at the restaurant to get a coffee before finally giving up and going to a nearby coffee shop. Lastly, the fitness center is small with one of the two ellipticals not working. There are better places in Brickell.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: It was a very pleasant experience

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: It was a very nice experience with family

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: Great location, off the main drag in Brickell. Stayed on Elite floor. Didn't hear much outdoor noise (but did hear people in the hallway). Nice to have Nespresso, but would have loved some real milk or cream, not the powder stuff. Breakfast is plentiful, but so unhealthy. Why not have UNsugared cereals, like basic Cheerios or Special K? Or plain Greek yogurt vs. sugary Yoplait? Gym good though small. Elevators take too long since there are only 3 for pretty large hotel.

Confortable rooms, neat and quiet. As to the restaurant Gold Coast, we received excellent and promt atentions, specially from Fanny and Aurea. They are both, nice and efficient persons always assisting us with a wonderful smile. I particularly, would like to enfasis this.

Fantastic stay at aventura. Lovely welcome when we got there and was given a free upgrade to the 12th floor skyline which we couldn’t thank them enough. The room was spacious and very modern. Everything was explained at the desk on how the room electrics work and the cleaners coming in every other day. We was given a map which the reception wrote down the shuttle frequencies and how to get to volcano bay which we couldn’t believe how close we was! Everything was comfortable and we really loved the touch of the fridge, safe, laundry service etc. the shuttles was one of the reason we stopped here. A lot of reviews elsewhere said shuttles weren’t frequent but at aventura they were and this was very true! We were always on one pretty much straight away or longest we waited was like 3 minutes which is really good! It’s a lot quieter the hotel which we loved even more because most people go to the themed hotels but we preferred this one over them by far. Wasn’t far from universal at all and you could see the firework show from the rooftop bar. We caught Ubers to Disney parks which were always very quick to get and cost about £20 each way which again was so much more worth doing this way as universal is the better parks! The wood fire pizza oven was amazing and urban pantry had a lot of variety. The staff especially Jen were so friendly and welcoming. I loved having the Starbucks in the lobby! The pool was really lovely and the area kept well clean. My only criticism of this and its not huge, but could do with more umbrella's around the pool and maybe umbrellas you could move. We was lucky to get a bed with one but we had to shadow chase when it got too hot or you had to move beds. The heat is hot and in the hotel it seems to increase a lot so could do with just some more spaces to cool down whilst staying around the pool. You could go to the bar but it’s not the same atmosphere as laying around the pool! The drinks on the rooftop bar weren’t so much for us. They weren’t what I would consider a cocktail but the vibe up there is so worth it for a night. We ordered takeaways a lot, after a day in the park it was nice to do and was so easy to do this on Uber eats we had no trouble what’s so ever. The shop did some great little presents and are the same price as in the parks. Would recommend staying here and when we come back again we would definitely come back and stay here again 100%

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: Great location and unbelievable service. My son left the pants of his suit and we just received it in the mail at our house. I have never in my life seen such thing, typically when you leave items behind and ask to retrieve it, they say that they don't know anything about or can't find it and they just take it. Not here! Grateful for their integrity and service.
Aurea was amazing! Great service 💪🏽
Aurea was amazing! Thanks a lot.

hotel_name: Homewood Suites by Hilton Miami-Airport/Blue Lagoon
review_text: Stayed in April before a cruise and this hotel was great! Stayed in a 2 bedroom with family and rooms were large and comfortable. Room had 2 kinds with separate bathrooms full kitchen and living space. Staff helped with booking the best shuttle to the port! Everything was simple and well planned by the hotel. Free breakfast was great also and a nice add since we had to leave early. My only recommendation would be to repair elevators. They had 1 down and the other was extremely slow.

hotel_name: Homewood Suites by Hilton Miami-Airport/Blue Lagoon
review_text: Very comfortable 2-bedroom suite. Free breakfast. Quiet, safe location. Very clean room. Shuttle was arranged by hotel and got us to the cruise port in about 30 minutes. Take the earliest shuttle you can… after 9:30 traffic becomes heavy. Construction at tunnel/bridge can get backed up for over an hour and a lot of Uber and Lyft drivers don’t want to sit in traffic.

hotel_name: Brickell Arch, A Luxury Collection Hotel, Miami
review_text: When I visited the hotel, the concierges Carlos and David were very helful during breakfast and shopping. Staff and breakfast are the best features of this hotel. During breakfast everyone was magnificent even manager Leandro stopped by to chat, with warmth and kindness, making a big difference on all the experience with patience, dedication and attention to details were simply exceptional. His genuine hospitality and commiment to excellence perfectly embody what a true luxury hotel experience should be.
Very kind staff The hotel was nice Great experience

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: Laicka and Rassoul's customer service, were excellent hosts at the Front Desk, were very attentive and friendly, answered all my questions and answered all my requests.
The hotel is super clean, all the staff really and the pool is amazing
I had a wonderful stay with Hyde and Jessa is super helpful and friendly. I will come back to stay for sure.
Ana was very warm and welcoming and respectful. Very attentive as well and made sure I had a great experience! Thank you, Ana!

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: This hotel has what you need for comfortable accommodation, especially if you are traveling for business and can get around by car. The location is good because it is in the middle of Miami, to go anywhere you need. If I had to go on holiday I probably wouldn’t choose it because it is at least a 30 minute drive from the beaches and shopping. The rooms are spacious and comfortable. And the lobby and conference spaces are super spacious and comfortable. The gym seemed small for the size of the hotel and the pool area is very good to enjoy the sun. I recommend it

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: The room was clean and the bed very comfy. Very quiet. The front desk was helpful. Lovely pool and surroundings. Nice bar area and bartender.

The restaurant has great ambiance and the food seasoned to perfection. It was quiet and the seating arrangement made dinner more intimate. Our waitress Sayda was also one of the bartenders and her attentiveness and service was excellent. She answered all of our questions and made our drinks to perfection.
Sayda the bartender was an angel. It has been a very long day and she provided spectacular service. Good food was really pretty darn good and the drinks were excellent.

hotel_name: Brickell Arch, A Luxury Collection Hotel, Miami
review_text: Initially, the title of my review was different, however when I visited the Brickell Arch Hotel website and read a great number of reviews mentioning Leandro, I decided to change it. Evidently, I too, can now express my gratitude to him for such a memorable experience during dinner on Friday, May 8th. Leandro is not merely a manager, he is the kind of person who is truly focused on service, on pleasing guests and ensuring a complete sense of satisfaction. I echo the words of another reviewer who stated and I quote "this industry needs many more Leandros". Thank you, thank you, thank you, for all of this and so much more.

The experience in Sonesta has been really good. The room is very clean and cozy. Ana, who works in the restaurant at night, is a very gentle person. By the way, the food is delicious. We really enjoyed our stay.

hotel_name: Holiday Inn Orlando International Dr-ICON by IHG
review_text: Had an amazing stay at the Holiday Inn International Dr.-ICON. The location was perfect — close to everything we needed, with easy access to restaurants, shopping, and local attractions. The hotel was clean, comfortable, and the service truly stood out. A special thank you to Avi at the front desk for providing exceptional customer service from check-in to check-out. Avi was friendly, professional, welcoming, and always ready to help with a smile. It’s employees like Avi who make guests feel valued and at home. Highly recommend this hotel for anyone looking for a great location and outstanding hospitality. We will definitely be back! Judith Delgado

Had another really pleasant stay at the Sonesta Hotel near Miami Airport — this being my second visit in the past 3 months, and somehow it felt just as accommodating as the first, if not even better. One thing that stood out immediately again was how calm and relaxing the atmosphere felt throughout the stay — especially appreciated after the chaos of travel. The hotel was consistently clean, well-kept, and comfortable, which made it easy to settle in and unwind. The service was also excellent. A special mention to Sayda, who was incredibly attentive, accommodating, and genuinely welcoming. Small details and good hospitality always make a difference, and she definitely elevated the experience. Overall, another smooth and comfortable stay with great service. Would gladly return again.

The rooms are perfect! I was given a free upgrade to 9th floor with a theme park view room! Loved it & was able to watch fireworks from there on my first night. The air con system is different to other resorts & made intermittent whooshing sounds (apparently that’s normal when it’s changing temperature) but once I’d gotten ear plugs from the team I slept very well. I’ve stayed at Sapphire Falls & cabana bay & their air con was silent- so this was odd but it was explained to me about the eco system used. Thank you. The service is excellent- your employees at every corner are just wonderful. Especially the lady with red hair at the rooftop bar! The roof top bar is my favourite bar in universal! I went every day for a glass of prosecco around 5;30 pm! The pool scene is great. The food is also really good/ I ate at the Rooftop bar once & the pantry for lunch twice. The only thing which I noticed is the drinks… for the price I feel like measures are a splash! An example, to have an Aperol spritz there are specific measures it should have to be an Aperol spritz & the times I bought these drinks the Aperol was definitely not what would make a proper Aperol spritz. If you’re charging the prices, the measure should be adhered to. It was the same for margaritas. I can only assume it’s the staff training & business decision to not provide proper measures. I went to sapphire falls & Royal Pacific & used their pools & had the perfect Aperol spritz & margaritas- so it does feel it’s a hotel specific issue. I also took advantage of being able to use the different hotel pools! It was great to return to Loews Sapphire & try out the Royal Pacific. I took the water taxi from Loews sapphire a couple of times but I honestly enjoyed the short walk in to the parks through Sapphire ! It’s not far at all. I’d return to this & in fact I’ll likely return next April with my daughter this time. Thank you

We had a truly delightful breakfast experience recently. Everything served was absolutely delicious and exceeded our expectations. Our server was attentive and incredibly helpful throughout our meal. We felt very well taken care of and appreciated the excellent service. It was a wonderful start to our day, and we highly recommend it.

We had a horrific experience at this over priced hotel, but not due to hotel's fault but a medical issue. Ease to take an uber is good. Room small but clean. Breakfast room service consisted of a delivery person handing over a paper bag with food, which was definitely subpar, and overpriced. When we called the front desk to enquire as to how to order room service, which tv stated was available, but not technically possible via the tv, we were instructed to go online with our personal phones and order via an app.......... I'm sorry but this is totally unacceptable for travellers who may be elderly or English not the first language. We arrived from a late flight due to a snow storm. The main desk person immediately tried to encourage us to eat in the restaurant before it closed in 10 minutes.... huh?? 9:30 pm.......Friday night....Food is definitely on our minds but hey, we don't need to be pressured at the time of check in. I only mention this as it was a very forceful encouragement to go to the restaurant immediately. Long story short.... my beef with this hotel is the little concession area downstairs, which we did go to, and once again were met with too late, we are closing. We got a slimy salad and cheese tray, and took back to our room to eat. Which we did, and nearing the end of the cheese tray, lo and behold was the mold. Disgusting. Does Marriott vet the third party people they allow to set up in their lobby? It was a huge relief when we checked out in the morning. In closing...... room was small and clean. AC worked well. Front desk staff pushy. Ease for Uber service good. Ride to cruise port 15 minutes. NOTE TO MARRIOTT... you need to think tank your pricing, and be cognizant that travellers are having to convert US dollars to their personal bank account ie..... some of us are spending huge amounts of money to travel, and you need to keep the business flowing or people will stop coming. Was this Marriott anything special???? NOT in the least!!!! I've travelled extensively and this. hotel is just run of the mill, in an easy location.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: My best friend and I had an absolutely phenomenal stay at this hotel, and we genuinely cannot stop talking about how incredible the experience was from start to finish. The location alone deserves five stars — perfectly situated in the heart of the city with easy access to public transportation, amazing restaurants, shopping, and so many of Miami’s must-see attractions. Everything felt effortlessly convenient, which made our trip even more enjoyable. What truly stood out was the atmosphere of the hotel. It had this perfect balance of lively Miami energy and refined professionalism. The space felt vibrant and exciting without ever feeling chaotic or overwhelming. From the moment we walked in, the hotel gave off an upscale, welcoming vibe that immediately made us feel comfortable and excited for our stay. Our room met or exceeded expectations in every way. It was beautiful, spacious, spotless, and thoughtfully designed. Every detail felt intentional and polished, and the level of cleanliness was honestly impressive. Housekeeping clearly takes great pride in maintaining the property because everything felt immaculate throughout our entire visit. One of the most surprising aspects was how quiet the hotel was, especially considering its downtown location. We expected at least some city noise, but our room was peaceful and relaxing at all hours. We both slept incredibly well every night, which says a lot in a busy city like Miami. The service was truly exceptional and easily comparable to what you’d expect at a luxury hotel. Every staff member we encountered was professional, warm, accommodating, and genuinely kind. The front desk team made us feel welcomed from the second we arrived, and they consistently went above and beyond throughout our stay. A very special thank you to Adrian at the bar, who made our experience even more memorable with his friendliness, professionalism, and generosity. He was outstanding and absolutely deserves recognition. The amenities were another highlight of the stay. Everything felt thoughtful, hospitable, and designed to make guests feel taken care of. We genuinely felt valued and cared for throughout the entire experience, which made the trip feel extra special. Overall, this hotel delivered an unbelievable value for everything it offers — prime location, beautiful accommodations, exceptional service, incredible cleanliness, and a truly elevated experience from beginning to end. We would return in a heartbeat and recommend it to anyone visiting Miami without hesitation. Five stars across the board!

hotel_name: Brickell Arch, A Luxury Collection Hotel, Miami
review_text: I organised and run an event here having visited the hotel back in February before it was a Marriott hotel. The transition from one brand to another happened after we had contracted our event and, to say the least, it was not smooth for us. So I will keep this review just about my experience as a guest over a 4-night stay. First of all, hats off to Mare Restaurant , excellent food especially at dinner and standout service with genuine warmth from Valentin. I’d also like to mention Nicole on the front desk who helped to overcome some of the transitional problems we experienced from brand to another. In general, this is a solid Brickell hotel with spacious and comfortable rooms and good facilities. It is also great for elevator geeks, if such a niche exists like aviation geeks or train geeks, for you spend a lot of time in elevators. It is up from the ground floor reception 25 floors to the Lounge where the great restaurant is located. Then down to your room in another elevator. Then if you want to use the pool it is up, down and up again in another elevator in a different building so an amazing 3 elevator rides. So if you love riding in elevators this is a truly outstanding hotel. All said, when next in Miami I would happily return.
We loved this boutique hotel! SO clean and conveniently located to the Miami cruise port. Mae & her staff were very friendly and helpful. We are already looking-forward to our next stay!
Sayda served us at the bar, and was absolutely lovely! She was kind and attentive, and a pleasure to talk to!
Sayda is a sweetheart! Very attentive service and the Old Fashioned was 5 stars!

Absolutely the worst hotel and experience I’ve had at a hotel. We were intimidated by the cleaner when she had to come back twice to clean the toilet from the previous guest. Patrick the manager thinks it’s acceptable to clean crusted urine and feces from the toilet and actually wipe inside the toilet bowl THEN TAKW THAT SAME TOILET CRUSTED RAG AND CLEAN THE BATHROOM VANITY WHILE MY TOOTHBRUSH IS LAYING ON THE COUNTER. This hotel needs to be shut down and tore down. By far the most uncivilized experience i’ve ever had at a hotel.

The staff were very friendly and helpful. Our check in time which was meant to be 4 was moved to 2pm when the room was ready. The chef was very accommodating to our food request and the dishes were delicious
Staff in general , very friendly , mainly the guys at the Restaurant 150% recommend, about tasty food and kindness. Thanks for everything as always.

Extremely central location in a lovely neighborhood, 5 minutes from the Design District, rooms are spacious and clean, and the staff are very attentive and helpful. We would especially like to thank Jessa at reception for her attentiveness and friendly demeanor. This will definitely be a hotel I'll stay at the next time I come to Miami!

I stayed at the Hyde Midtown for a business trip and really enjoyed it. The room was spacious and spotless; the pool and gym were both lovely. Easy to walk to different places thought Midtown, Wynwood, and the Design District. Jessa and George at the front desk were super nice and friendly, and Jessa really went out of her way to make me feel welcome. Overall a very pleasant stay!
I stayed at the hotel for two days. My respects go to the young woman from Nicaragua who cleans in the early hours of the morning, keeping the lobby impeccable.

hotel_name: Homewood Suites by Hilton Miami-Airport/Blue Lagoon
review_text: Excellent stay, shuttle to airport was very pleasant. Kudos to the shuttle driver who was very kind.

hotel_name: Homewood Suites by Hilton Miami-Airport/Blue Lagoon
review_text: The driver, Yuri was great. They were working on one of the elevators, which has been the case the last 3 times we have stayed there.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: Back to Miami Not to be missed, a renewed hotel Hall, breakfast area and Pool. But the most important , the staff: Special thanks to Ernest ,netche Ann, liscia, Wilda ( Front desk) Frey ( breakfast attendant) And of course Carlos,( the concierge).
Great service from the front desk team, including George, at the Hyde hotel in Midtown Miami. The team was extremely kind and very accommodating, will definitely stay again.

Well today we head home with mixed emotion on this place . Firstly yes it’s central and a good variety of places to eat and drink. And the staff are very polite. However we have had 11 nights here and it was on the 2nd night my daughter woke up with quite a few bites on her. My granddaughter who was in the same room but different bed wasn’t bitten at all. We obviously brought this up to management who moved our rooms straight away. Gave tokens to wash s there clothes and gave a free breakfast. We were delayed getting to the park and it ended up costing us some of our lightning lane bookings. The manager said they got independent company in to investigate and the found nothing so they ended it there. I asked to see the findings at which point the company policy doesn’t allow it. I’m not nocking the hotel or the staff but it did have an effect on my granddaughter whom it was her first trip to the USA and Disney. There was definitely evidence that they went through the room as we took photos. ( bed base was discusting ) so we have to accept the outcome. Would we stay here again , probably yes. I would like to thank the management for their prompt action . But I think they could be better at their cleaning.

What I liked the most is the location, situated on Biscayne Boulevard; it is a good point to head out to different places in Miami, and it is also close to the airport. A lot of tranquility, impeccable cleanliness, the room is spacious, and the bed is very comfortable. It has parking on its premises, and no additional fees are charged. This hotel is a highly recommended option. There are very good places nearby the hotel for breakfast, lunch, and dinner, including places where several Argentinians work, which are also very good options.

We recently stayed at the Rosen inn pointe Orlando over Easter We were a family of four sharing one room We had an amazing trip from start to finish and the Rosen was a great base to hit all the parks especially universal and sea world which were close by we had a hire car to get to Disney which is about a 20 mins drive Rossen inn is in a great location on international drive with loads of restaurants and bars within close walking distance after a full on day at the parks! Rossen inn rooms are a little dated but it was only a base for us to sleep after being out all day! The rooms were clean and fresh towels everyday Really great staff always friendly and helpful Nice bar serving food and drinks and a coffee and gift shop a normal shop selling snacks and essentials and a restaurant which we only used for the buffet breakfast which was decent The hotel is a universal partner hotel so there was a complementary bus service to the universal parks which you need to book the day before Overall I wouldn't really recommend the rossen inn really good value for money and a great hotel to explore the parks and all the great things Orlando has to offer

Our stay at the Arlo hotel was perfect. The best part was the staff; Andrés at the reception was very kind and resolved all our questions immediately. In the restaurant, Víctor served us wonderfully, being very attentive and professional; both made our vacation even better! 100% recommended Thank you, Andrés and Víctor The Spaniards and the Cuban one
Julio gave the best service possible. The view from my room was magnificent
Very comfortable room, quiet, excellent bed and shower. Lots of dining alternatives on the same street and within a block of the hotel. Friendly staff.
Nice hotel with easy to use technology in the room
Our stay and breakfast were amazing! Thank you to Aurea for the best service at Gold Coast Kitchen!

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: I had a terrible experience. Starting with the check-in. I had a reservation made by Blue Travel, paid in advance, voucher printed, all ok! Arriving there the completely unprepared employees simply said that they didn't find my reservation, that there was nothing with my name there, and said they couldn't do anything. I called the blue travelers said everything was okay and opened an internal help to call the hotel to try to resolve. I arrived super early at the hotel, we were with two little children, arriving from travel, tired and committed at 17hs. My boy fell at the reception, hurt his mouth, nothing supported anyone willing to help. I've been calling Blue for 4 hours, the super blue assistant asks, trying to help. So that after that time a whole hotel employee (seems to have been the manager) found my reservation, says he was in another system. Hi???!!!!! How is it? At least they had to have looked into all their systems before making me wait this whole time at the reception with two little children. Completely frustrated. review_text: Shaun was great at the reception . Very nice location

We love this hotel. This is our second stay as a family. We do find this area fantastic with access to Bayside and Brickell within a short walk. We did Lyft to the beach $21. We also visited the Nu Stadium and this was $38 one way. Whole foods on the next block. The hotel facilities are excellent, pool area on the 16th floor is excellent, pools warm, lovely view and Area 31 was great. Towels provided and also suncream. The gym is fab and all you need. Parking and valet parking both excellent. We had a room on the 26th floor facing into the city, the view was excellent but there was some street noice, but very little when doors closed. We requested a pet free room as my husband has allergies, this was accommodated. We did notice several dogs around. We loved sitting on the balcony watching the yachts go up and down the river. All staff we encountered were incredible, really went the extra mile. We can’t wait to return.

hotel_name: Holiday Inn Orlando International Dr-ICON by IHG
review_text: Very nice and clean! Close to a ton of restaurants and things to do! Staff is super welcoming. Anaya helped check us in and she was great!! She’s a 10/10!!

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites Miami Wynwood Design District
review_text: Our stay at the Hampton Inn & Suites Miami Wynwood Design District was absolutely fantastic and provided the perfect start to our vacation before our cruise. As we were celebrating our 10th wedding anniversary, the team went above and beyond to prepare an unforgettable surprise for us. The lovely flowers, beautiful room decorations, and thoughtful arrangements were truly remarkable and created a lasting memory. Our accommodations were excellent; the room was spacious, and the large floor-to-ceiling windows offered a wonderful view of the vibrant street below. Throughout our stay, the staff displayed incredible kindness, consistently checking in to see if we needed anything, offering great local recommendations, and seamlessly arranging our shuttle to the cruise port. Breakfast was also highly enjoyable, with a helpful team always ready to assist. Logistically, the location is unbeatable. The property is just a short walk from the area's famous artsy murals and galleries. Having a pharmacy and several great restaurants nearby was also incredibly convenient for tackling all of our last-minute pre-cruise needs. We would definitely return to this property if we find ourselves in Miami again.

We transferred to Universal Aventura for 5 nights after 9 nights at Disney. Following the manic, busy atmosphere of the Disney Hotel (which was fab), Aventura was like an oasis of calm and tranquility! There’s obviously going to be children everywhere, but Aventura is designed to appeal more to the older clientele, there was no real Universal overkill, just the shop and everything so tastefully designed and airy. The lifts were central and the wings all had their own colour so finding which direction you needed to go in was easy. Receptionist on check in was lovely. In fact everyone was that we met. Bar 17 at the top, views are amazing. Rooms were lovely, clean, beds comfy and all the gadgets appealed to a couple of big kids! Only negative was that the sink was very ‘gluggy’ and made loud gurgling noises throughout the night. I wouldn’t hesitate coming back again, it was absolutely fabulous ☺️

hotel_name: Holiday Inn Orlando International Dr-ICON by IHG
review_text: I love staying at this hotel! The rooms are super spacious and always very clean. Shaun at the front desk is great too! Definitely recommend staying here if you’re looking for a safe, clean, inexpensive LBV area hotel.

We spent this past Sunday and Monday nights at the Kimpton Epic Hotel by IHG in Miami. It was an outstanding stay in every way possible…We were celebrating my husband’s birthday. The staff was welcoming, professional and engaging. The suite was beyond exquisite with Panaramic views of the city as well as the water. Walls of floor to ceiling glass enhanced our stay. The balcony was huge and wrapped around the entire suite. Patricio greeted us immediately upon arrival. We instantly bonded~ he made us feell like family. A true gentleman. Pedro was our server for our lunch and two breakfasts. He was absolutely wonderful and caring and treated each person in the restaurant with kindness and respect. The housekeepers did an amazing job. Our rooms were kept immaculate. Thank-you to Calvin (manager) for our suite assignment. It was beyond awesome !!! Jhanathan carried our luggage out to our car and gave us our final good-bye leaving a lasting happy impression. We highly recommend this Kimpton and really look forward to a return visit 😎😎😎

review_text: Se have been holding Board Meetings and vendor events at Hampton Inn Brickell for many years. The hotel in the past 3 years has gone thru renovations and the meeting rooms are comfortable, and the AV system is up to current requirements. The value for money is always key and the professional and at the same time relaxing atmosphere is great. The location couldn't be better. Minutes' walk to Brickell City Center.

review_text: My husband used points to book this hotel for my daughter and I. When we arrived and realized the room was in his name we were told we had to call the third party company it was booked thru. They said they were unable to change the name on the reservation, meaning my daughter and I could not check in. We were panicked!! Jasmine at the front desk jumped thru hoops to make it happen that we could check in, she was a lifesaver!!! I was so thankful for her help! The hotel is beautiful and clean! Really thankful for Jasmine- who turned around what potentially would have been a really frustrating situation!!
Overall the stay was amazing with a great view, breakfast was great the server was Coronado, and valet at checking out was above and beyond by Jean Baptiste.
Jean Bapt was a great help when I was coming in and leaving, the pace was really beautiful.

Usually we stay in Royal Pacific or the Hard Rock hotel two of Universal’s “premium” hotels but for some reason the prices were coming in ridiculously high, literally twice the price of previous years so we had to drop down a level, with some trepidation. So glad I did, we had a wonderful stay, walking distance (if you’re relatively active) to the parks which we did a number of times but also free transportation if you wish, a lovely room, they kindly honoured my request for a certain level & view which really made the experience better. The pool was great, staff excellent, more slightly adult related so far more relaxing at night and around the pool. We bought Express passes separately and even with this we saved hundreds staying here compared to the other hotels, that impressed that I’ll probably opt to stay here in the future over the premium hotels.

This hotel is absolutely gorgeous and feels like a real tropical getaway without really getting away! My now fiance used this location to set up the most perfect surprise proposal a surprise engagement photoshoot - with help from the staff! The rooms were so beautiful, and they went above and beyond by sending complimentary champagne up to our upgraded room, all as a congratulatory gesture to our engagement. 10/10 and most definitely will be staying there again soon! Amazing service by such a great team. Huge thank you to: Kenya, David, Emily P., Emily R., FD, Fabricio, Aaron, Ariana and Gregory.

After nearly two hours, a manager finally informed us that the hotel was already aware the dryer was broken and that we would need to change rooms. The issue was the lack of transparency, poor communication, wasted time and the complete failure to take ownership of the situation. Having travelled extensively and stayed in hotels around the world, this was one of the most poorly handled service recoveries I have experienced. Unfortunately, I would not stay here again.

I stayed at The Elser Miami to celebrate my birthday and unfortunately my experience fell far below expectations, especially considering the cost of the stay and the reputation of the property. Upon arrival, my room was not properly prepared. The microwave was dirty, the TV remote did not work, and I had to contact staff for assistance. Throughout my stay, housekeeping services were inconsistent. I made multiple requests for housekeeping and replenishment of items, but service was delayed and appeared rushed when it was finally completed. I also found expired items among the snacks and beverages provided in the room, which was concerning from both a quality control and guest safety standpoint. The most frustrating issue involved billing. After checkout, I noticed charges that I did not recognize and had to contact the hotel myself for an explanation. I was initially charged for minibar items that I did not consume. Although the charge was eventually removed, I was never provided with proof of what items I was supposedly accused of taking. As a guest, I should not have to dispute charges that were incorrectly applied in the first place. There was also significant confusion regarding credits, refunds, and charges. I was told one amount would be credited to my account, but later received different information from management. Even after multiple emails, I still do not feel that my questions regarding the charges and credits have been fully addressed. The worst part of my stay occurred on checkout day. The elevators were not functioning properly, creating major delays for guests trying to leave the property. My boyfriend and I were forced to carry our luggage down numerous flights of stairs in order to leave for the airport. Because of these delays, two Uber drivers canceled on us, and we were left scrambling to avoid missing our flight. What was most disappointing was the lack of assistance and concern shown to guests. A simple apology was offered, but no meaningful effort was made to address the inconvenience. When I later contacted management with a detailed explanation of the issues I experienced—including the room condition, housekeeping concerns, billing discrepancies, minibar accusations, elevator outage, transportation delays, and physical strain caused by carrying luggage down multiple floors—I received a response that addressed only a small portion of my concerns while ignoring many of the others. The hotel itself is beautiful and the location is convenient, but guest service, communication, billing transparency, and problem resolution need significant improvement. Based on my experience, I would not choose to stay here again, nor would I recommend it to others expecting a luxury hotel experience.

They only clean rooms once every two nights and if you leave a single personal item on your bed they will disregard it entirely. The front desk will not inform you of this. The hotel was ok as a base for visiting the parks but the cleanliness standards were not what we expected… The room and hotel areas felt quite dirty, and we also had issues with noise from dogs barking and whining throughout the day, which made it difficult to relax after long days out. The biggest disappointment was having a personal item taken from our room during housekeeping (taken whilst we were out). I reported it immediately and completed a lost & found form, but despite chasing this several times during our stay, I received no updates or resolution. After returning home, I contacted Guest Services twice to request reimbursement for the item and received an acknowledgement stating someone would respond within 48 hours. Three weeks later, I still have had no response… It’s disappointing because the issue itself was small, but the lack of communication, ownership and customer service made the situation much worse! Another issue during our stay was the constant pressure from Wyndham services staff. We were approached repeatedly every day when trying to book a park shuttle, despite making it clear we were not interested. I would not recommend this hotel if you are looking for a clean, modern or comfortable place to relax after busy days. I stayed here 7 years ago too and unfortunately very little appears to have changed, the hotel feels dated and in need of updating. If you are only looking for a basic place to sleep and store your bags while spending most of your time at the parks, then it may be suitable, but I would not choose to stay here again based on the cleanliness, outdated condition and the poor handling of issues during our stay.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: I do not usually write many reviews and I should have written this back in March after our stay at the Hampton Inn & Suites, I have made a conscious effort to battle with my prehistoric login details and make a point of writing a review for this hotel. I stayed in March 2026 with my husband and 6 year old son - we are from the UK and this was a pre-cruise stay leaving from Miami port. The hotel is in a great location, just by Brickell Station so we were able to get the Miami Mover train at the airport to the station and 15 mins later at Brickell - for something like $5 for us all! Hotel is lovely, reception staff were attentive and welcoming. Our room was clean with excellent facilities. I has signed up to Hilton rewards and received a welcome gift with water/snack which was very appreciated after a long day of travelling across the pond! BREAKFAST - was soo soo good! My son enjoyed making the waffles himself and there was a great selection of hot and cold foods. Enough to set you up for a busy day in Miami and this saved us a lot of money!! We went to the pool which was nice - never too busy and views of skyscrapers really set the scene that we were in Miami. We had free drink vouchers given to us at check in which we used in the hotel bar. This was a large clean area - same as used for breakfast - which was a nice place to chill out. PLOT TWIST - we enjoyed this hotel so so much, that we actually pushed our flights back after our cruise and stayed a further two nights to finish exploring Miami. That is how much I would recommend it! I did see a transfer bus to the port for cruises which looked well organised. We used an Uber which was easy and took around 40 mins with traffic. I noticed lots of guests were cruisers, some co-corporate and many with children. There is a fantasic gastropub located next to the hotel - same building - called Batch. We ate here each evening and it was the perfect american experience. I will review independently but I would strongly recommend it if you are staying.

Worse, when we spoke about this to the manager Eli the next day, he first claimed that the incident never happened, there was no such phone call and that I was lying. When I sent him the proof, he changed his tune and said that maybe it did happen but since it was eventually resolved (which it was by ~2 AM), I shouldn't be complaining. I then reached out to the manager Terry about this, who didn't even bother to respond.
Manuel was very kind to me and my family.

I recently stayed at The Elser Hotel. This is the third time I have stayed here. The location is great, the beds are very comfortable and the service is usually really good. The bellmen were fantastic, both Aleandro and Fabien could not have been better bellman, helping us 6 girls with 16 bags constantly. Carlos in the package room was exceptional. I left a package there during my last stay and he kindly held it for me over the policy of 30 days. I am so appreciate of this level of service. The last time I stayed the concierge was also fabulous however this time I was confused and disappointed with the service I received from the young girl behind the desk there (not the same girl as last time). She didn't seem to know anything and couldn't actually help with any of our questions or requests. My iPrefer status was supposed to give me a late (1pm or 2pm) checkout. I called all morning from my room and even went to concierge to ask about this and despite them always saying they would call back and let me know, no one did. We were running late as there had also been a fire drill at 10:30am and we all had to walk down 17 floors to exit the building. I'm not concerned about a fire drill as I know these tests are necessary to carry out but never receiving a phone call back even despite me saying I am happy to pay extra for late check-out just went ignored. I will definitely be back hoping this was just an rare, unfortunate experience.

This came in handy as I rented a car and drove to Key Largo and Islamorado one day. The lonby is large and airy and upscale with that Miami vibe. Great stay here!

I am extremely disappointed with our experience at the InterContinental Miami. We specifically called ahead before our stay and made two requests: (1) a room with a view facing the 4th of July fireworks, and (2) reservations for two people for the hotel’s 4th of July pool deck celebration. We were assured over the phone that both requests would be taken care of. When we arrived, we discovered that neither promise had been honored. Our room did not face the fireworks as promised, and the front desk informed us that the 4th of July celebration had already sold out and that no reservations had been made for us. If the hotel could not accommodate these requests, we would have appreciated honesty from the beginning instead of being told everything was confirmed. We planned our holiday around these promises, only to arrive and find out they were never fulfilled. It completely changed our experience and was a huge disappointment. For a hotel that markets itself as providing exceptional service, this level of miscommunication and lack of follow-through is unacceptable. We expected much better, especially for a special holiday stay. Unfortunately, based on this experience, we cannot recommend this hotel and will not be staying here again in the future.
